1.t: dhal bha(n)jan gur sooramaa vadd jodhaa bahu paraupakaaree|
1.e: This Guru, the vanquisher of armies, is very brave and benevolent.

1.g: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਲਾਂ ਤਕਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ।
1.t: puchhan sikh aradhaas kar chhia mahalaa(n) tak dharas nihaaree|
1.e: The Sikhs prayed and asked that they have seen the six Gurus (how many more are to come) .

1.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬੋਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ।
1.t: agam agochar satiguroo bole mukh te sunahu sa(n)saaree|
1.e: The true Guru, the knower of the unknowable and seer of the invisible told the Sikhs to listen to.

1.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਸੋਢੀਆਂ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨੀਂਵ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਖਲਾਰੀ।
1.t: kalijug peeRee soddeeaa(n) nihachal nee(n)v usaar khalaaree|
1.e: The lineage of the Sodhis have been established on the sound foundation.

1.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੪੮॥
1.t: jug jug satigur dhare avataaree ||48||
1.e: Four more Gurus will come to earth (yuga 2, yuga 2 i.e. 2+2=4)

1.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪੯ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ
1.t: pauRee 49 : vaahiguroo ma(n)tr
1.e: Waheguru mantar

1.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਸਦੇਵ ਵਵਾ ਵਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ।
1.t: satijug satigur vaasadhev vavaa visanaa naam japaavai|
1.e: In Satyug, Visnu in the form of Vasudev is said to have incarnated and ‘V’ Of Vahiguru reminds of Visnu.

1.g: ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰੀਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਹਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ।
1.t: dhuaapar satigur hareekirashan haahaa har har naam japaavai|
1.e: The true Guru of dvapar is said to be Harikrishan and ‘H’ of Vahiguru reminds of Hari.

1.g: ਤੇਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਰਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
1.t: tete satigur raam jee raaraa raam jape sukh paavai|
1.e: In the the treta was Ram and ‘R’ of Vahiguru tells that remembering Ram will produce joy and happiness.

1.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਗਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ।
1.t: kalijug naanak gur gobi(n)dh gagaa gobi(n)dh naam alaavai|
1.e: In kalijug, Gobind is in the form of Nanak and ‘G’ of Vahiguru gets Govind recited.

1.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
1.t: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chain vich jai samaavai|
1.e: The recitations o f all the four ages subsume in Panchayan i.e. in the soul of the common man.

1.g: ਚਾਰੋ ਅਛਰ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ।
1.t: chaaro achhar ik kar vaahaguroo jap ma(n)tr japaavai|
1.e: When joining four letters Vahiguru is remembered,

1.g: ਜਹਾ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪੯॥੧॥
1.t: jahaa te upajiaa fir tahaa samaavai ||49||1||
1.e: The jiv merges again in its origin.

2.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
2.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
2.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of the divine preceptor

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਵਸਤੂ ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ ਮੰਗਲਾਚਰਣ
2.t: pauRee 1 : vasatoo niradhesh ma(n)galaacharan
2.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of the divine preceptor

2.g: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਰਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ।
2.t: aapanaRai hath aarasee aape hee dhekhai|
2.e: The mirror (in the form of world) is in the hand (of the Lord) and man sees of himself in it.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਭੇਖੈ।
2.t: aape dhekh dhikhaidhaa chhia dharasan bhekhai|
2.e: God visualises and makes men see the guises and  philosophies of six Schools (in this mirror).

2.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਮੂਹ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਲਿਦਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੈ ਲੇਖੈ।
2.t: jehaa mooh kar bhaalidhaa tevehai lekhai|
2.e: Man is reflected (in the mirror) in exactly the same way as is his propensity.

2.g: ਹਸਦੇ ਹਸਦਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਸੋ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
2.t: hasadhe hasadhaa dhekheeaai so roop sarekhai|
2.e: The laughing person finds a  laughing form in it.

2.g: ਰੋਦੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਦਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ।
2.t: rodhai dhisai rovadhaa hoe nimakh nimekhai|
2.e: Whereas the wailing person finds himself (as well as everybody) there in the weeping posture. Same is the case of a clever person.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa satisa(n)g visekhai ||1||
2.e: The Lord Himself is prevading this world-mirror but He is specifically preceivable in and through the holy congregation.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਵਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 2 : vaja(n)tree dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of an instrumentalist

2.g: ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹਥਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਾਗ ਵਜਾਏ।
2.t: jiau ja(n)tree hath ja(n)tr lai sabh raag vajaae|
2.e: The Lord resembles to an instrumentalist who holding the instrument in his hand plays all the different measures on it.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ।
2.t: aape sun sun magan hoi aape gun gaae|
2.e: Listening to the tunes played he remain immersed in them and eulogises the Supreme.

2.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪਿ ਰੀਝਿ ਰੀਝਾਏ।
2.t: sabadh surat liv leen hoi aap reejh reejhaae|
2.e: Merging his consciousness in the Word he becomes elated and makes others also delighted.

2.g: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
2.t: kathataa bakataa aap hai surataa liv laae|
2.e: Lord is the speaker as well as the listener immersed in super consciousness.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰਬੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ।
2.t: aape hee visamaadh hoi saraba(n)g samaae|
2.e: Himself all bliss He premeates one and all.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥੨॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh pateeaae ||2||
2.e: This mystery that the Lord is omnipresent, is only understood by a gurmukh, the Guru oriented one.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ
2.t: pauRee 3 : aape raseeaa aap rasu
2.e: Himself the enjoyer as well as the joy

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਸੋਈ।
2.t: aape bhukhaa hoi kai aap jai rasoiee|
2.e: He (the Lord) Himself posing to be hungry goes into the kitchen and cooks the food kneading in it all sorts of delights.

2.g: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਦਾ ਰਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਸ ਗੋਈ।
2.t: bhojan aap banaidhaa ras vich ras goiee|
2.e: Himself eating and getting  satiated He showers praises on the dainty dishes.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ।
2.t: aape khai salaeh kai hoi tirapat samoiee|
2.e: He Himself is the delight as well as the delighted.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭੋਈ।
2.t: aape raseeaa aap ras ras rasanaa bhoiee|
2.e: He is the juice as well as the tongue which relishes its taste.

2.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੁ ਸਮੋਈ।
2.t: dhaataa bhugataa aap hai saraba(n)g samoiee|
2.e: He permeating through all, Himself is the giver as well as receiver.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh hoiee ||3||
2.e: Knowing the fact that He permeates among all, the Gurmukh feels immense pleasure.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪ : ਉਹ ਹੀ
2.t: pauRee 4 : uh hee
2.e: Himself the enjoyer as well as the joy

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਲੰਘੁ ਵਿਛਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਉਂਦਾ।
2.t: aape pala(n)gh vichhai kai aap a(n)dhar sau(n)dhaa|
2.e: He Himself spreads the bedstead and Himself reclines on it.

2.g: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਉਂਦਾ।
2.t: suhane a(n)dhar jai kai dhesa(n)tar bhau(n)dhaa|
2.e: Entering into the dreams, He wanders through far off regions.

2.g: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਉਂਦਾ।
2.t: ra(n)k raau raau ra(n)k hoi dhukh sukh vich pau(n)dhaa|
2.e: Making the poor a king and the king a poor person He puts them in pain and pleasure.

2.g: ਤਤਾ ਸੀਅਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਲੁ ਆਵਟਣੁ ਖਉਂਦਾ।
2.t: tataa seearaa hoi jal aavaTan khau(n)dhaa|
2.e: In the form of water He Himself gets hot and cold.

2.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਾਂਵਦਾ ਚਾਵਾਏ ਚਉਂਦਾ।
2.t: harakh sog vich dhaa(n)vadhaa chaavaae chau(n)dhaa|
2.e: Amidst sorrows and delights, He moves around and responds to the call when called.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਉਂਦਾ ॥੪॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh rau(n)dhaa ||4||
2.e: The gurmukh, realising  His nature of premeating through all, attains happiness.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਭੇਦ
2.t: pauRee 5 : adhikaaree bhedh
2.e: Deserving distinctions

2.g: ਸਮਸਰਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ।
2.t: samasar varasai savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh jiau sabhanee thaiee|
2.e: As the drops of rain in the svati nakstr (fifteenth star formation among the) twenty seven star formations known in india) fall equally at all places,

2.g: ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਈ।
2.t: jal a(n)dhar jal hoi milai dharatee bahu bhaiee|
2.e: And falling into water they merge in water and on earth they become earth;

2.g: ਕਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਘਣੇ ਫਲੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਈ।
2.t: kirakh birakh ras kas ghane fal ful suhaiee|
2.e: At places it transforms into plants and vegetation, sweet and bitter; at some places they are well adorned with myriad flowers and fruits.

2.g: ਕੇਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
2.t: kele vich kapoor hoi seetal sukhadhaiee|
2.e: Falling on the banana leaves they transform into cooling camphor.

2.g: ਮੋਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਪ ਮੁਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਲ ਮੁਲਾਈ।
2.t: motee hovai sip muh bahu mol mulaiee|
2.e: The same when they fall into a sea-shell become pearls.

2.g: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਦੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਚਿਤਵੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ।
2.t: biseear dhe muh kaalakooT chitave buriaaiee|
2.e: Gone into the mouth of a snake they turn into deadly poison and always think evil.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa satisa(n)g subhaiee ||5||
2.e: The Lord prevades all places and sits in state in the holy congregation.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਸੰਗਤ ਦਾ ਅਸਰ
2.t: pauRee 6 : sa(n)gat dhaa asar
2.e: Effect of the company  -

2.g: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਕੈਹਾਂ ਹੋਈ।
2.t: soiee taa(n)baa ra(n)g sa(n)g jiau kaihaa(n) hoiee|
2.e: Mixing with tin, the copper transforms into bronze.

2.g: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਜਿਸਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿਤਲ ਅਵਲੋਈ।
2.t: soiee taa(n)baa jisat mil pital avaloiee|
2.e: The same copper mixed with zinc appears in the form of brass.

2.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੀਸੇ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਭੰਗਾਰ ਭੁਲੋਈ।
2.t: soiee seese sa(n)gatee bha(n)gaar bhuloiee|
2.e: Copper mixed with lead changes pewter, a brittle metal called bharath in the Punjab.

2.g: ਤਾਂਬਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੋਈ।
2.t: taa(n)baa paaras parasiaa hoi ka(n)chan soiee|
2.e: With the touch of the philosopher’s stone, the same copper becomes gold.

2.g: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਖਧ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਈ।
2.t: soiee taa(n)baa bhasam hoi aaukhadh kar bhoiee|
2.e: When transformed into ashes copper becomes a medicine.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਈ ॥੬॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa sa(n)gat gun goiee ||6||
2.e: Likewise, though the Lord is omnipresent, yet the effects of the company of man are different over men. Knowing this much, the Lord is eulogised in the holy congregation.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਜਲ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 7 : jal dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of water

2.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਲੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਾ ਦਿਸੈ।
2.t: paanee kaale ra(n)g vich jiau kaalaa dhisai|
2.e: As water mixed with black dye looks black

2.g: ਰਤਾ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਲਿਸੈ।
2.t: rataa rate ra(n)g vich mil mel salisai|
2.e: And mixed with red water becomes red;

2.g: ਪੀਲੈ ਪੀਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਿਤੁ ਜੇਹੀ ਵਿਸੈ।
2.t: peelai peelaa hoi milai hit jehee visai|
2.e: It turns out to be yellow adding yellow dye;

2.g: ਸਾਵਾ ਸਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਰਿਸੈ।
2.t: saavaa saave ra(n)g mil sabh ra(n)g sarisai|
2.e: And with the green becomes pleasure-giving green.

2.g: ਤਤਾ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਹਿਤ ਜਿਸੈ ਤਿਸੈ।
2.t: tataa Tha(n)ddaa hoi kai hit jisai tisai|
2.e: According to the seasons it becomes hot or cold.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਿਸੈ ॥੭॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh jisai ||7||
2.e: Likewise, the Lord God operates to the needs (of creatures). The Guru-oriented (gurmukh) who is full of joy understands this mystery.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਹੋਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 8 : hor dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Other examples

2.g: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ।
2.t: dheevaa balai baisa(n)tarahu chaanan anhere|
2.e: Fire lits the lamp and light scatters in the darkness.

2.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਵਿਚਹੁਂ ਮਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਮ ਆਇ ਲਿਖੇਰੇ।
2.t: dheepak vichahu(n) mas hoi ka(n)m aai likhere|
2.e: The ink obtained from the lamp is used by the writer.

2.g: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ।
2.t: kajal hovai kaamanee sa(n)g bhale bhalere|
2.e: From that lamp women get collyrium.

2.g: ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਦਫਤਰ ਅਗਲੇਰੇ।
2.t: masavaanee har jas likhai dhafatar agalere|
2.e: With the same ink are written eulogies of the Lord and the clerk writes accounts in his office.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਫੇਰੇ ॥੮॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh chaufere ||8||
2.e: Only gurmukh realises this fact, that the Lord pervades all around.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਅਨੇਕਤਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਏਕਤਾ
2.t: pauRee 9 : anekataa vi'ch ekataa
2.e: Unity in diversity

2.g: ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਰਦਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ।
2.t: birakh hovai beeau beejeeaai karadhaa paasaaraa|
2.e: From seed comes up the tree and then it spreads further.

2.g: ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੇਡ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਡਾਲ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ।
2.t: jaR a(n)dhar pedd baaharaa bahu ddaal bisathaaraa|
2.e: Root extends in earth, the stem outside and the branches extend all around.

2.g: ਪਤ ਫੁਲ ਫਲੀਦਾ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਸਵਾਰਾ।
2.t: pat ful faleedhaa ras ra(n)g savaaraa|
2.e: It becomes full of flowers, fruits, and means of many colours and delightful essences.

2.g: ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਉਲਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ।
2.t: vaas nivaas ulaas kar hoi vadd paravaaraa|
2.e: In its flowers and fruits dwell fragrance and joy and now this seed becomes a large family.

2.g: ਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਉ ਸੰਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਫਲ ਫਲੇ ਹਜਾਰਾ।
2.t: fal vich beeau sa(n)jeeau hoi fal fale hajaaraa|
2.e: Again the fruit by producing seeds becomes the source of myriad flowers and fruits.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh nisataaraa ||9||
2.e: Understanding of this very fact that the Lord alone is among all makes the gurmukh liberated.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਸੂਤ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 10 : soot dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of thread

2.g: ਹੋਵੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਪਾਹ ਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਣਾ ਵਾਣਾ।
2.t: hove soot kapaeh dhaa kar taanaa vaanaa|
2.e: From cotton the thread and then its warp and waft is prepared.

2.g: ਸੂਤਹੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਆਖਾਣ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
2.t: sootahu kapaR jaaneeaai aakhaan vakhaanaa|
2.e: It is well known that from that very thread the cloth is made.

2.g: ਚਉਸੀ ਤੈ ਚਉਤਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲੁ ਜਾਣਾ।
2.t: chausee tai chautaar hoi ga(n)gaa jal jaanaa|
2.e: Made of the four  threads are what are known as chausi, gangajali etc.(in india).

2.g: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਤਨ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ।
2.t: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf tan sukh man bhaanaa|
2.e: The superior clothes (malmal, sirisaph) made out of it impart comfort and pleasure to the body.

2.g: ਪਾਗ ਦੁਪਟਾ ਚੋਲਣਾ ਪਟੁਕਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
2.t: paag dhupaTaa cholanaa paTukaa paravaanaa|
2.e: By becoming turban, scarf, waist coat etc. that thread from cotton becomes acceptable to one and all.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh ra(n)g maanaa ||10||
2.e: The Lord permeates among all and the gurmukhs enjoy His love.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਸੋਨੇ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 11 : sone dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of gold

2.g: ਸੁਨਿਆਰਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਘੜੈ ਗਹਣੇ ਸਾਵਾਰੇ।
2.t: suniaaraa suinaa ghaRai gahane saavaare|
2.e: The goldsmith creates beautiful ornaments out of gold.

2.g: ਪਿਪਲ ਵਤਰੇ ਵਾਲੀਆ ਤਾਨਉੜੇ ਤਾਰੇ।
2.t: pipal vatare vaaleeaa taanauRe taare|
2.e: Among them many are like pipal leaf for adornment of ears and many are made of gold wire.

2.g: ਵੇਸਰਿ ਨਥਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੰਠ ਮਾਲਾ ਧਾਰੇ।
2.t: vesar nath vakhaaneeaai ka(n)Th maalaa dhaare|
2.e: From gold, nose-rings and necklaces are also worked into their shape.

2.g: ਟੀਕਤਿ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੋਤਿਸਰ ਗਜਰੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ।
2.t: Teekat maneeaa motisar gajare paasaare|
2.e: Ornament for the forehead (tikka), jewels studded necklace, pearl garlands are made.

2.g: ਦੁੱਰ ਬੁਹੱਟਾ ਗੋਲ ਛਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ।
2.t: dhu'r buha'Taa gol chhaap kar bahu parakaare|
2.e: Variegated wrist chains and round rings are prepared from gold.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh veechaare ||11||
2.e: The gurmukh feels that like gold He is the basis of each and every thing.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਗੰਨੇ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 12 : ga(n)ne dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of sugarcane

2.g: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਦਰਹਾਲਾ।
2.t: ga(n)naa koloo peeReeaai ras dhe dharahaalaa|
2.e: Crushed by the crushing machine sugarcane gives juice instantly.

2.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁੜੁ ਭੇਲੀਆਂ ਕੋ ਸਕਰ ਵਾਲਾ।
2.t: koiee kare guR bheleeaa(n) ko sakar vaalaa|
2.e: Some prepare lumps of jaggery and brown sugar out of it.

2.g: ਕੋਈ ਖੰਡ ਸਵਾਰਦਾ ਮੱਖਣ ਮੱਸਾਲਾ।
2.t: koiee kha(n)dd savaaradhaa ma'khan ma'saalaa|
2.e: Some prepare refined sugar and some adding in it sweet drops make special jaggery.

2.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਕਲੀਕੰਦ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਢਾਲਾ।
2.t: hovai misaree kaleeka(n)dh miThiaaiee ddaalaa|
2.e: It is moulded into lump sugar and variegated sweets.

2.g: ਖਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
2.t: khaavai raajaa ra(n)k kar ras bhog sukhaalaa|
2.e: The poor and the wealthy both eat it with pleasure.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧੨॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukhaalaa ||12||
2.e: God (similar to sugarcane juice) permeates through all; for gurmukhs He is the essence of all the pleasures.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਗਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਧ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 13 : gaa(n) dhe dhu'dh dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of cow-milk

2.g: ਗਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਧੁ ਉਜਲੁ ਵਰਣਾ।
2.t: gaiee ra(n)g bira(n)g bahu dhudh ujal varanaa|
2.e: Cows are of different hues but the milk of all is white.

2.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਜਮਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਰਣਾ।
2.t: dhudhahu dhahee jamaieeaai kar nihachal dharanaa|
2.e: For making curd Some rennet is added into it and then it is placed undistributed.

2.g: ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਇ ਅਲੋਈਐ ਛਾਹਿ ਮਖਣ ਤਰਣਾ।
2.t: dhahee viloi aloieeaai chhaeh makhan taranaa|
2.e: By churning curd one finds butter over the butter milk.

2.g: ਮਖਣੁ ਤਾਇ ਅਉਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਘਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣਾ।
2.t: makhan tai aauTai kai ghiau niramal karanaa|
2.e: The butter boiled properly is transformed into ghee – clarified butter.

2.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਰਣਾ।
2.t: hom jag nieevedh kar sabh kaaraj saranaa|
2.e: Then that ghee is used as burnt offering and him yajn(rituals) and other oblation are performed.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਰਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh hoi jaranaa ||13||
2.e: Gurmukh knows that the Lord is all pervading but to reach Him one has to have  spiritual quest as well as the sense of contentment.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਸੂਰਜ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 14 : sooraj dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Example of sun

2.g: ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਹਰਿ ਥਿਤ ਵਾਰ ਗਣਾਏ।
2.t: pal ghaReeaa moorat pahar thit vaar ganaae|
2.e: From moments, the gharis (a unit of time equal to 22).

2.g: ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਬਣਾਏ।
2.t: dhui pakh baareh maeh kar sa(n)jog banaae|
2.e: (5 minutes), muhurat (auspicious time), the quarters of day and night (pahar – three hourstime) dates and days have been counted. Then joining two fortnights (dark- light) and twelve months have been made.

2.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਵਰਤਾਈਆਂ ਬਹੁ ਚਲਿਤ ਬਣਾਏ।
2.t: chhia rutee varataieeaa(n) bahu chalit banaae|
2.e: Many inspiring visuals have been created through the six seasons.

2.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਵੇਦ ਅਲਾਏ।
2.t: sooraj ik varatadhaa lok vedh alaae|
2.e: But as the knowledgeable persons say, the sun remains the same among these all.

2.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾਂ ਬਹੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲਾਏ।
2.t: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa(n) bahu pa(n)th chalaae|
2.e: Similiarly, four varans, six philosophies and many sects have been promulgated,

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥੧੪॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh samajhaae ||14||
2.e: But the gurmukh understands all (and hence there should be no in-fightings).

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਉਹੀ ਭਾਵ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 15 : uhee bhaav baisa(n)tar dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Same idea-example of fire

2.g: ਇਕੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਇਕ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਉਪਾਏ।
2.t: eik paanee ik dharat hai bahu birakh upaae|
2.e: The water is one and the earth is also one but the flora is of variegated qualities.

2.g: ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਸੁਹਾਏ।
2.t: afal safal parakaar bahu fal ful suhaae|
2.e: Many are devoid of fruits and many are adorned with flowers and fruits.

2.g: ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ।
2.t: bahu ras ra(n)g suvaasanaa parakirat subhaae|
2.e: They have diverse kinds of fragrance  and by their many kinds of extracts they enhance the grandeur of Nature.

2.g: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਏ।
2.t: baisa(n)tar ik varan hoi sabh taravar chhaae|
2.e: The same fire is there in all trees.

2.g: ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਭਸਮੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ।
2.t: gupatahu paragaT hoi kai bhasama(n)t karaae|
2.e: That unmanifest fire becoming manifest reduces all to ashes.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh paae ||15||
2.e: Likewise, that (unmanifest) Lord resides in all and this very fact makes Gurmukhs full of  delight.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਬਿਰਦ ਪਾਲਨ
2.t: pauRee 16 : biradh paalan
2.e: Living up to one's natural repute

2.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ।
2.t: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat sabh cha(n)dhan hovai|
2.e: The whole vegetation planted near sandal tree becomes fragrant like sandal.

2.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਢੋਵੈ।
2.t: asaT dhaat ik dhaat hoi sa(n)g paaras ddovai|
2.e: Being in touch with the philosophers’s stone and the alloy of light metals transforms into one metal (gold).

2.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੰਗ ਗੰਗੋਵੈ।
2.t: nadheeaa naale vaahaRai mil ga(n)g ga(n)govai|
2.e: Rivers, streams and brooks after joining the Ganges are known by the name of Ganges.

2.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ।
2.t: patit udhaaran saadhasa(n)g paapaa(n) mal dhovai|
2.e: The redeemer of the fallen ones is the holy congregation wherein the dirt of sins is cleansed.

2.g: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗੋਵੈ।
2.t: narak nivaar asa(n)kh hoi lakh patit sa(n)govai|
2.e: Myriads of apostates and hells have obtained redemption through and in the holy congregation.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲੋਵੈ ॥੧੬॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh alovai ||16||
2.e: The gurmukh beholds and understands that God pervades one and all.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ
2.t: pauRee 17 : prem
2.e: Love

2.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਤੰਗ ਦਾ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਤਰੰਦਾ।
2.t: dheepak het pata(n)g dhaa jal meen tara(n)dhaa|
2.e: Moth loves burning lamp and fish goes on swimming in water for love of It.

2.g: ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਵਰ ਕਵਲਿ ਵਸੰਦਾ।
2.t: mirag naadh visamaadh hai bhavar kaval vasa(n)dhaa|
2.e: For deer the musical sound is the source of delight, and the black bee being in love for lotus gets enveloped in it.

2.g: ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ।
2.t: cha(n)dh chakor pareet hai dhekh dhiaan dhara(n)dhaa|
2.e: The redlegged patridge (chakor) loves the moon and concentrates upon it.

2.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਣੰਦਾ।
2.t: chakavee sooraj het hai sa(n)jog bana(n)dhaa|
2.e: Female ruddy sheldrake (chakavi) loves the sun and only on sunrise it meets and mates with its patner.

2.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਂ ਪੁਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
2.t: naar bhataar piaar hai maa(n) put mila(n)dhaa|
2.e: Woman loves her husband and it is love that the mother brings forth the son.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੰਦਾ ॥੧੭॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh paracha(n)dhaa ||17||
2.e: Beholding Him operative in all, the gurmukh feels contented.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
2.t: pauRee 18 : a'khaa(n) dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
2.e: Examples of organs-eyes etc.

2.g: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਸਭ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
2.t: akhee a(n)dhar dhekhadhaa sabh choj viddaanaa|
2.e: Through the eyes (of the world) He beholds all the wondrous feats.

2.g: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾਣਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
2.t: ka(n)nee sunadhaa surat kar aakhaan vakhaanaa|
2.e: With full consciousness He listens to the stories narrated.

2.g: ਜੀਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
2.t: jeebhai a(n)dhar boladhaa bahu saadh lubhaanaa|
2.e: Through tongue, He speaks and relishes all the tastes.

2.g: ਹਥੀਂ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਂਵਦਾ ਪਗਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ।
2.t: hathee(n) kirat kamaa(n)vadhaa pag chalai sujaanaa|
2.e: He works with hands and He, the  Omniscient One, walks on feet.

2.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
2.t: dhehee a(n)dhar ik man i(n)dhree paravaanaa|
2.e: In body, He is the mind whose orders are obeyed by all the organs.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh maanaa ||18||
2.e: Understanding (the fact) that He permeates through all, gurmukhs feel delighted.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੇ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ
2.t: pauRee 19 : sirashaTee te sirashaTe dhaa praba(n)dh
2.e: The relation between the creation and the creator

2.g: ਪਵਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ।
2.t: pavan guroo gur sabadh hai raag naadh veechaaraa|
2.e: The basis of the world is air (the mixture of gases) and Sabad (Word) is the Guru of all knowledge from which flow further all thoughts, music and attendant sounds.

2.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ।
2.t: maat pitaa jal dharat hai utapat sa(n)saaraa|
2.e: Mother and father are the creative forces in the form of earth and water.

2.g: ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਵਰਤੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
2.t: dhaiee dhaiaa raat dhih varate varataaraa|
2.e: Night and day are the nurses who nurse for the creatures and this way the whole system goes on operating.

2.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
2.t: siv sakatee dhaa khel mel parakirat pasaaraa|
2.e: With the combination of Siva (the consciousness) and Sakti (the inert nature) this whole world comes into being.

2.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਘਟਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਕਾਰਾ।
2.t: paarabraham pooran braham ghaT cha(n)dh akaaraa|
2.e: That transcendental perfect Lord is permeating through all as the same moon in the sky is visualised in all the pitchers of water.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਾ ॥੧੯॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh niradhaaraa ||19||
2.e: That Lord beyond all the sustenances is the sustenance for the gurmukhs and He alone operates through all.

2.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਪ
2.t: pauRee 20 : aap hee aap
2.e: He and He alone is

2.g: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
2.t: fulaa(n) a(n)dhar vaas hai hoi bhavar lubhaanaa|
2.e: The Lord is the fragrance in flowers and becoming black bee He is attracted towards flowers.

2.g: ਅੰਬਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਸ ਧਰੇ ਕੋਇਲ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣਾ।
2.t: a(n)baa(n) a(n)dhar ras dhare koil ras maanaa|
2.e: Sap in the mangoes is He and becoming nightingale He enjoys the same.

2.g: ਮੋਰ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਘਣ ਵਰਸ ਸਿਞਾਣਾ।
2.t: mor babeehaa hoi kai ghan varas sin(j)aanaa|
2.e: Becoming peacock and the rain bird (papthd) only He identifies the delight in raining of the clouds.

2.g: ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੋਇ ਕਲੀਕੰਦ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
2.t: kheer neer sa(n)jog hoi kaleeka(n)dh vakhaanaa|
2.e: He transforms Himself into variegated sweets by becoming milk and water.

2.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਣਾ।
2.t: oa(n)kaar akaar kar hoi pi(n)dd paraanaa|
2.e: The same Formless Lord assuming different forms is residing in all the bodies.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੨੦॥੨॥
2.t: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh paravaanaa ||20||2||
2.e: He is omnipresent in all substances and activities and gurmukhs bow before all such stages.

3.e: One Oankar, the primal enegy, realised through The grace of divine preceptor.
One Oankar, the primal enegy, realised through The grace of divine preceptor.
I bow before the primeval Lord who has been told as the primordial cause of all.

3.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਣਿਆ।
3.t: so satigur sachaa ves sabadh sin(j)aaniaa|
3.e: Truth incarnate that true Guru is realised through the Word.
Only they have realised Him whose surati (consciousness) has merged into the truth after accepting the commands of the Word.
Holy congregation is the genuine basis and authentic abode of truth.
Wherein the individual inspired by loving devotion enjoys the innate delight.
Lord, kind to the devotees and the glory of the poor, also assimilates Himself in the holy congregation.

3.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
3.t: brahamaa bisan mahes a(n)t na jaaniaa|
3.e: Even Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa could not know His mysteries.

3.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਹਸਿ ਫਣ ਸੇਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ।
3.t: simar sahas fan ses til na pachhaaniaa|
3.e: Sesanag remembering Him with its thousand hoods could not understand Him.
The truth is pleasing to those gurmukhs who have become dervish at the door of holy congregation.
Guru and disciple

3.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਭੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: gur chele raharaas alakh abheau hai|
3.e: The ways of the Guru and the disciple are mysterious and imperceptible.

3.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: gur chele saabaas naanak dheau hai|
3.e: Guru (Nanak) and disciple (Angad) both are blest (because both have merged into each other).

3.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: gurmat sahaj nivaas sifat sameau hai|
3.e: Their abode is the wisdom of Guru and they both are rapt in the praises of the Lord.

3.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: sabadh surat paragaas achhal achheau hai|
3.e: Enlightened with the Word their consciousness has become infinite and immutable.

3.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਅਰਖੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: gurmukh aas niraas mat arakheau hai|
3.e: Transcending all hopes they have assimilated subtle wisdom in their person.

3.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: kaam karodh vinaas sifat sameau hai|
3.e: Conquering the lust and anger they have absorbed themselves in the praises (of God).

3.g: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਉਲਾਸ ਸਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: sat sa(n)tokh ulaas sakat na seau hai|
3.e: Beyond the abodes of Siva and Sakti they have reached the abode of truth, contentment and  bliss.

3.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚੇਉ ਹੈ।
3.t: ghar hee vich udhaas sach sucheau hai|
3.e: Being indifferent to household (pleasures) they are truth-oriented.

3.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
3.t: veeh ikeeh abhiaas gur sikh dheau hai ||2||
3.e: The Guru and disciple have now attain the ratio of twenty and twenty One, i.e. the disciple has gone ahead of the Guru.
Guru and disciple
The disciple who obeys the commands of the Guru is called gurmukh.
The actions of  the gurmukh are awe-inspiring and their glory is indescribable.
Considering creation as the form of the Creator he feels to be a sacrifice unto it.
In the world he feels himself as a guest and the world a guest house.
Truth is his real Guru whom he speaks and listens to.
Like a  bard, at the doors of the holy congregation, he recites the hymns of the Guru (gurbani).
For him the holy congregation is the basis of his acquaintance with the omniscient Lord.
His consciousness remains absorbed in the graceful true Word.
True court of justice for him is the holy congregation and through Word the true identity of it he establishes in his heart.
Guru and disciple

3.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ।
3.t: sabadh guroo gur vaahu gurmukh paiaa|
3.e: From the Guru the disciple obtains the wondrous Word
And as a disciple, merging his consciousness in it, comes face to face with imperceptible Lord.
Meeting the Guru, the disciple attains turia, the fourth and final stage  of spiritual quietude.
He holds unfathomable and serene Lord dearly in his heart.
Becoming carefree that true disciple merges himself in the truth.
And by becoming the king of kings he makes others subservient to him.
Only he loves the divine will of the Lord.
And only he has tasted the nectar in the form of praises of the Lord.
Taking consciousness into the depth of Word, he has shaped the unchiselled mind.
The gurmukh-wayfarer

3.g: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ।
3.t: mul na milai amol na keemat paieeaai|
3.e: The way of life of gurmukhs is invaluable;

3.g: ਪਾਇ ਤਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ।
3.t: pai taraajoo tol na atul tulaieeaai|
3.e: It cannot be purchased; on weighing scale it cannot be weighed.

3.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਈਐ।
3.t: nij ghar takhat addol na ddol ddolaieeaai|
3.e: Stabilizing in one’s own self and not getting frivolous in his way of life.

3.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ ਨ ਰਲੇ ਰਲਾਈਐ।
3.t: gurmukh pa(n)th nirol na rale ralaieeaai|
3.e: This way is distinct and does not become defiled even when joined with some one else.

3.g: ਕਥਾ ਅਕਥ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਬੋਲ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ।
3.t: kathaa akath abol na bol bulaieeaai|
3.e: Its story is indescribable.

3.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਅਭੋਲੁ ਨ ਭੋਲਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ।
3.t: sadhaa abhul abhol na bhol bhulaieeaai|
3.e: This way transcends all ommissions and all anxieties.
Absorbed in equipoise this gurmukh-way of life gives balance to life.
The gurmukh quaffs from  the tank of nectar.

3.g: ਲਖ ਟੋਲੀ ਇਕ ਟੋਲੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
3.t: lakh Tolee ik Tol na aap ganaieeaai ||5||
3.e: The end result of lacs of experiences is the gurmukh  never exhibits his ego.
The merchandise of a gursikh
From the shop of holy congregation, through the Word, the merchandise of God’s name is procured.

3.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਟਿ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ।
3.t: pooraa poore vaT k aakh salaaheeaai|
3.e: How to praise Him? The measuring criteria of  the perfect Lord are perfect.

3.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਐ।
3.t: kadhe na hovai ghaT sachee patisaaheeaai|
3.e: The warehouse of the True King is never deficient.
Cultivating the True Guru, those who earn through Him get merged into His inexhaustible Being.
The company of the saints is manifestly great; one should always be in and with it.

3.g: ਚਾਵਲ ਇਕਤੇ ਸਟਿ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਹੀਐ।
3.t: chaaval ikate saT na dhoojee vaaheeaai|
3.e: Husk in the form of maya should be separated from the rice of life

3.g: ਜਮ ਦੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਦਾਦਿ ਇਲਾਹੀਐ।
3.t: jam dhee faahee kaT dhaadh ilaaheeaai|
3.e: With strokes of discipline during this very life.

3.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਟਿ ਸੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹੀਐ।
3.t: pa(n)je dhoot sa(n)ghaT su dderee ddaaheeaai|
3.e: All the five evil propensities, should be decimated.

3.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿਹਟਿ ਸੁ ਖੇਤਿ ਉਮਾਹੀਐ ॥੬॥
3.t: paanee jiau harihaT su khet umaaheeaai ||6||
3.e: As the  water of well keeps the fields green, the field of the consciousness should be kept verdant (with the help of shabad).
The true guru

3.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਈ।
3.t: pooraa satigur aap na alakh lakhaaviee|
3.e: Lord Himself is the true Guru who is imperceptible.

3.g: ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਈ।
3.t: dhekhai thaap uthaap jiau tis bhaaviee|
3.e: Of His own will He Establishes or uproots.

3.g: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਈ।
3.t: lep na pu(n)n na paap upai samaaviee|
3.e: The sin and virtue of creation and destruction do not touch Him at all.

3.g: ਲਗੂ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਸਰਾਪ ਨ ਆਪ ਜਣਾਵਈ।
3.t: lagoo var na saraap na aap janaaviee|
3.e: He never makes anybody notice Him and boons and curses do not stick to Him.
The true Guru recites the Word and unfolds the grandeur of that indescribable Lord.

3.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਨ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਈ।
3.t: akath kathaa jap jaap na jagat kamaaviee|
3.e: Eulogosong the ineffable (Lord) he does not indulge in hypocrisy and guile.
The effulgence of the perfect Guru finishes off the ego of the seekers of knowledge.
The Guru effacing the three suferings (god-sent, physical and spiritual) lessens the anxieties of the people.

3.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੭॥
3.t: gurbaanee man dhraap nij ghar aaviee ||7||
3.e: Getting satiated by the teachings of such a Guru, the individual stays in his innate nature.

3.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਲਈ ਸਾਧਨ ਦਸ਼ਾ ਤੇ ਵਰਤਨ
3.t: pauRee 8 : gursi'khaa(n) liee saadhan dhashaa te varatan
3.e: Means for the Sikhs, their state and conduct  ,
The perfect Guru is truth incarnate who is realised by becoming gurmukh.
The desire of the true Guru is that the Word should be sustained;
Burning the ego one will get honour in the court of Lord.

3.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲੀਐ।
3.t: ghar hee jog jugat baisan dharamasaaleeaai|
3.e: One should learn the technique of merging in the Lord by considering one’s home as the place for cultivating dharma.
Liberation for them is certain who abide by the teaching of the Guru.
They having loving devotion in their heart remain jubliant.
Such people are emperors full of delight.
Becoming egoless  they serve the sangat, congregation, by bringing water, grinding corn etc. for it.
In humility and joy they lead altogether distinct life.
Characteristics of gurmukhs
The Guru preaches to the Sikh to be pure in conduct.
He (gurmukh) joining the congregation remains absorbed in the Word.
In the company of flowers the sesame oil also becomes scented.
Nose – string of God’s Will remains in the nose of the Sikh of the Guru i.e. he always keeps himself ready to be  subservient to the Lord.
Taking bath in the ambrosial hours he remains enrapt in the region of the Lord.

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਵੇਸਿਆ।
3.t: gur jap ridhai suhel gur paravesiaa|
3.e: Remembering Guru in his heart he becomes one with Him.

3.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭੇਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਸਰੇਸਿਆ।
3.t: bhaau bhagat bhau bhel saadh saresiaa|
3.e: He having the fear of the Lord and a loving devotion, is known as the sadhu of high stature.

3.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਲ ਨਵੇਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਸਿਆ।
3.t: nit nit naval navel gurmukh bhesiaa|
3.e: The fast colour of the Lord goes on compounding on a gurmukh.
The gurmukh only remains with the supreme Lord who is the giver of supreme delight and fearlessness.
The dust of the feet

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: gur moorat kar dhiaan sadhaa hajoor hai|
3.e: Concentrate upon the Guru-word considering it as the figure of the Guru who is always with you.

3.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਦੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: gurmukh sabadh giaan neR na dhoor hai|
3.e: Due to the knowledge of the Word, the gurmukh finds the Lord always near and not far off.

3.g: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: purab likhat neesaan karam a(n)koor hai|
3.e: But the seed of karmas sprouts according to the previous karmas.

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: gur sevaa paradhaan sevak soor hai|
3.e: The valiant servant becomes leader in doing service to the Guru.

3.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਦ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: pooran param nidhaan sadh bharapoor hai|
3.e: God, the supreme store house is always full and omnipresent.
His glory shines forth in the holy congregation of the saints.

3.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਭਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਠਰੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: lakh lakh saseear bhaan kiran Tharoor hai|
3.e: The brightness of myriads of moons and suns is subdued before the light of the holy congregation.

3.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਚੂਰ ਹੈ।
3.t: lakh lakh bedh puraan keeratan choor hai|
3.e: Millions of Vedas and Puranas are insignificant before the praises of the Lord.

3.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਧੂਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੦॥
3.t: bhagat vachhal paravaan charanaa dhoor hai ||10||
3.e: The dust of the feet of the beloved of the Lord is dear to the gurmukh.
Oneness of the Guru and the Sikh

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
3.t: gur sikh sikh gur soi alakh lakhaiaa|
3.e: Being one with each other the Guru and the Sikh have made the Lord  perceptible (in the form of Guru).

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੈ ਸਿਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
3.t: gur dheekhiaa lai sikh sikh sadhaiaa|
3.e: Getting initiated by the Guru, the disciple has become a Sikh.

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ।
3.t: gur sikh i'ko hoi jo gur bhaiaa|
3.e: It was the Lord’s desire that the Guru and the disciple would become one.
It seems as if the diamond cutting the diamond has brought the other one in one string;
Or the wave of water has merged in water, or the light of one lamp has come to reside in another lamp.
The wondrous deed (of the Lord) seems to have been transformed into a parable.
It is as if the sacred ghee has been produced after churning the curd.
The One Light has scattered in all the three worlds.
It is as if the sacred ghee has been produced after churning the curd.
Oneness of the Guru and the Sikh

3.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇਆ।
3.t: satigur naanak dheau guraa gur hoiaa|
3.e: The True Guru Nanak Dev was the Guru of Gurus.
He installed Guru Angad Dev on the invisible abd mysterious throne of equipoise.
Merging Amar Das into the external Lord he made him see the invisible.
Guru Ram  Das was made to quaff the delight of supreme nectar.

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਉ ਢੋਐ ਢੋਇਆ।
3.t: gur arajan kar seau ddoaai ddoiaa|
3.e: Guru Arjan Dev got the largess of service (from Guru Ram Das).
Guru Hargobind also churned the sea (of Word)
And due to the grace of all these truthful personalities, the truth of the Lord has come to reside in the hearts of common people, who have fully devoted their selves to the Word.
Even empty hearts of the people have been filled by sabad, the Word

3.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇਉ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
3.t: gurmukh abhar bhareau bharam bhau khoiaa ||12||
3.e: And the Gurmukhs have exterminated their fears and delusions.
Gurmukh

3.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਹਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: saadhasa(n)gat bhau bhaau sahaj bairaag hai|
3.e: Fear (of God) and love (for mankind) being diffused in the holy congregation the sense of non-attachment always prevails.

3.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: gurmukh sahaj subhaau surat su jaag hai|
3.e: By nature, the Gurmukhs  remian alert i.e. their consciousness remains attuned to Sabad, the Word.

3.g: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਆਲਾਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: madhur bachan aalaau haumai tiaag hai|
3.e: They speak sweet words and they have already expelled ego from their  selves.

3.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਥਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: satigur mat parathaau sadhaa anuraag hai|
3.e: Conducting themselves according to the wisdom of the Guru they always remain imbued in love (of the Lord).

3.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਸਾਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: piram piaale saau masatak bhaag hai|
3.e: They feeling fortunate quaff the cup of love (of the Lord).

3.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਉ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: braham jot brahamaau giaan charaag hai|
3.e: Realising the light of the Supreme in their  mind they become competent to light the lamp of divine knowledge.

3.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਉ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਅਦਾਗੁ ਹੈ।
3.t: a(n)tar gurmat chaau alipat adhaag hai|
3.e: Due  to the wisdom obtained from Guru they have unlimited enthusiasm and  they remain untouched by maya and the dirt of the evil propensities.

3.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥
3.t: veeh ikeeh chaRhaau sadhaa suhaag hai ||13||
3.e: In the context of worldliness, they always conduct themselves in a superior position i.e. if the world is twenty, they are twenty one.
Gurmukh
The words of gurmukh should always be cherished in one’s heart.
By the  benevolent glance of the gurmukh one becomes blest and happy.
Rare are those who attain the sense of discipline and service.
Gurmukhs being full of love are kind to the poor.
Gurmukh is ever steadfast and always adheres to the teachings of the Guru.
One should seek jewels and rubies from the gurmukhs.
Gurmukhs are devoid of deception; they, without becoming victim of Time, go on enjoying the delight of devotion.
Gurmukhs have discriminatory wisdom of swans (who can separate milk from water), and they with their mind and body love their Lord.

3.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਦਾ ਗੁੱਝਾ ਭੇਦ
3.t: pauRee 15 : mool ma(n)tr dhaa gu'jhaa bhedh
3.e: Mystery of the Mulmantr
By writing 1 (One) in the beginning, it has been shown that Ekankar, God, who subsumes all forms in Him is only one (and not two or three).
Ura,  the first Gurmukhi letter, in the form of Oankar shows the world controlling power of that one Lord.
That Lord has been understood as the True-Name, Creator and the Fearless One.
He is devoid of rancour, beyond time and free from the cycle of transmigration.
Hail the Lord! His mark is truth and He shines in bright effulgent flame.
Five letters (1 Oankar) are altruists; they have in them the power of the person of the Lord.
The individual, understanding their import becomes blest with graceful glance of God who is the essence of delights.

3.g: ਨਉ ਅੰਗਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਿਆ।
3.t: nau a(n)g su(n)n sumaar sa(n)g niraaliaa|
3.e: As the numerals from one to nine adding zero with them reach to the infinite count
The persons who quaff the cup of love from their beloved become master of infinite powers.

3.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਦੇ ਏਕੋ ਭਾਈ
3.t: pauRee 16 : chaar varan dhe eko bhaiee
3.e: Unity among the four varnas
The people of all the four varnas sit together in the company of gurmukhs.
All the disciples become gurmukh as betel leaf, lime and chatehu when mixed become of one red colour.
All the five sounds (produced by different instruments) keep the gurmukhs full of joy.
In the waves of the Word of the true Guru, gurmukhs ever remain in delight.

3.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਸੰਗ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੰਗ ਮੇਲਿਆ।
3.t: sabadh surat parasa(n)g giaan sa(n)g meliaa|
3.e: Joining their consciousness to the Guru’s teachings, they become knowledgeable.
They keep themselves absorbed day and night in the great resonance of Gurbani, the holy hymns.
Drowned into the infinite Word and its steadfast colour only the One (God) is realised.
Out of the twelve ways (of yogis) the way of the gurmukhs is the correct way.
Collyrium of the Gursikhs
In the primordial times the Lord ordained.
The Word of the Guru met with the Sabda-brahm Word-God and the ego of creatures got erased.
This  very awe-inspiring word is the collyrium of gurmukhs.
Adopting Gurmat, the wisdom of the Guru, with the grace of the Guru, the delusions are  eschewed.
That primordial being is beyond time and destruction.
He  bestows grace upon His servants like Siva and Sanaks et al.
In all the ages only He is remembered and He alone is the object of concentration of the Sikhs.
Through the taste of the cup of love that Supreme Love is known.
Since the primordial time He has been delighting all.
The true disciple

3.g: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਨ ਗਲੀ ਹੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: muradhaa hoi mureedh na galee hovanaa|
3.e: Only by becoming dead in life, i.e. totally detached, and not through mere verbal jargon one can become a true disciple.

3.g: ਸਾਬਰੁ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਸਹੀਦੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: saabar sidhak saheedh bharam bhau khovanaa|
3.e: One could be such a person only after getting sacrificed for truth and contentment and by eschewing delusions and fears.
The true disciple is a boughten slave who is ever busy in the service of the Master.

3.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਖਾਣਾ ਸੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: naa tis bhukh na needh na khaanaa sovanaa|
3.e: He forgets hunger, sleep, food and rest.
He  grinds fresh flour (for free kitchen) and serves by fetching water.

3.g: ਪਖੇ ਦੀ ਤਾਗੀਦ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: pakhe dhee taageedh pag mal dhovanaa|
3.e: He fans (the congregation) and washes nicely the feet of the Guru.

3.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜੀਦੁ ਨ ਹਸਣੁ ਰੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: sevak hoi sa(n)jeedh na hasan rovanaa|
3.e: The servant  always remains disciplined and has nothing to do with wailing and laughing.

3.g: ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਵਣਾ।
3.t: dhar dharaves raseedh piram ras bhovanaa|
3.e: This way he becomes dervish at the door of the Lord and gets drenched in the delights of the rains of love.
He will be seen as the first moon of Id day (which the Muslims eagerly wait for in order to break their long fasts), and only he will come out as a perfect man.
What is demanded of a disciple  ?

3.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਮੁਰੀਦੈ ਥੀਵਣਾ।
3.t: pairee pai paa khaak mureedhai theevanaa|
3.e: By becoming the dust of the feet the disciple is required to be near the feet of the the Guru.

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ।
3.t: gur moorat musataak mar mar jeevanaa|
3.e: Becoming an avid suiter of the form (word) of the Guru and being dead to greed, infatuation and other relational propensities, he should remain alive in the world.
Repudiating all worldly connections he must remain dyed in the colour of the Lord.

3.g: ਹੋਰ ਨ ਝਖਣੁ ਝਾਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਵਣਾ।
3.t: hor na jhakhan jhaak saran man seevanaa|
3.e: Seeking no shelter elsewhere he should keep his mind absorbed in the shelterof God, the Guru.

3.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪਾਕ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ।
3.t: piram piaalaa paak amia ras peevanaa|
3.e: Sacred is the cup of the love of the beloved; he should quaff that only.
Making humility his abode he should get poised in it.
Divorcing the (tastes of ) ten organs i.e.not being caught in their dragnet, he should attain equipose.

3.g: ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕ ਨ ਮਨ ਭਰਮੀਵਣਾ।
3.t: saavadhaan gur vaak na man bharameevanaa|
3.e: He must be fully conscious about the word of Guru and should not allow the mind to be entrapped in delusions.
Absorption of consciousness in the Word makes  him alert and this way one gets across the Word – ocean.
Who is the acknowledged Sikh   ?
He is true Sikh who surrenders before the Guru and bows his head;

3.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਥਾ ਲਾਇਆ।
3.t: gur charanee chit lai mathaa laiaa|
3.e: Who puts his mind and forehead on the feet of Guru;
Who holding dear to his heart the teachings of the Guru expels ego from his self;
Who loves the will of Lord and has attained equipoise by becoming Guru-oriented, gurmukh;

3.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ।
3.t: sabadh surat liv lai hukam kamaiaa|
3.e: Who by merging his consciousness in the Word has acted according to the divine Will (hukam).

3.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
3.t: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai nij ghar paiaa|
3.e: He (the true Sikh) as the result of his love and fear of holy congregation attains his own self (atma).
He remains stuck to the lotus feet of the Guru like the bumblebee.
Getting enveloped in this delight  he goes on quaffing the nectar.
Blessed is the mother of such a person. Only his coming to this world is fruitful.

4.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
4.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
4.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the Grace of the divine preceptor

4.g: ੧ : ਵਸਤੂ ਨ੍ਰਿਦੇਸ ਮੰਗਲ। ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਦੇਹ ਸਫਲ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਹੈ?
4.t: 1 : vasatoo niradhes ma(n)gal| manu'khaa dheh safal kive(n) hai?
4.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the Grace of the divine preceptor

4.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਧਾਰੇ।
4.t: oa(n)kaar akaar kar paun paanee baisa(n)tar dhaare|
4.e: Oankar transforming into forms created air, water and fire.

4.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਦੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
4.t: dharat akaas vichhoRian cha(n)dh soor dhe jot savaare|
4.e: Then separating earth and sky He threw two flames of sun and moon in between them.

4.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ।
4.t: khaanee chaar ba(n)dhaan kar lakh chauraaseeh joon dhuaare|
4.e: Further creating the four mines of life He created eighty four lacs of species and their animalcules.

4.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ।
4.t: eikas ikas joon vich jeea ja(n)t anaganat apaare|
4.e: In each species further are born myriads of creatures.

4.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ।
4.t: maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai safal janam gur saran udhaare|
4.e: Among them all, the human birth is the rare one.  One should, in this very Birth, liberate himself by surrendering before the Guru.

4.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
4.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv bhai bhagat gur giaan veechaare|
4.e: One must go to holy congregation; the consciousness should be merged in the word of the Guru and cultivating only a loving devotion, one should undertake to follow the path shown by the Guru.

4.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
4.t: paraupakaaree guroo piaare ||1||
4.e: The man by becoming altruist becomes beloved of the Guru.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ
4.t: pauRee 2 : ni(n)mrataa
4.e: Humility

4.g: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਹੋਈ ਓਡੀਣੀ।
4.t: sabh dhoo(n) neevee dharat hai aap gavai hoiee oddeenee|
4.e: The earth is the most humble which eschewing ego is firm and steady.

4.g: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਪੈਰਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੀ।
4.t: dheeraj dharam sa(n)tokh dhiraR pairaa heTh rahai liv leenee|
4.e: Deeply rooted in fortitude, dharma and contentment it remains tranquil under feet.

4.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਣ ਛੁਹਿ ਆਢੀਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਖੀਣੀ।
4.t: saadh janaa(n) dhe charan chhuh aaddeenee hoiee laakheenee|
4.e: Touching the holy feet of the saints, it earlier being worth half a penny now becomes worth lacs.

4.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਛਲਕ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੀਣੀ।
4.t: a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaavanee chhahabar chhalak ren hoi reenee|
4.e: In the rain of love, the earth gets satiated with delight.

4.g: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਇ ਪਤੀਣੀ।
4.t: miliaa maan nimaaneeaai piram piaalaa peei pateenee|
4.e: Only the humble get adorned with glory and the earth, quaffing the cup of the love of the Lord gets satiated.

4.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਲੁਣੈ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਣੀ।
4.t: jo beejai soiee lunai sabh ras kas bahu ra(n)g ra(n)geenee|
4.e: Amongst variegated flora, sweet and bitter tastes, and colours on earth, one reaps whatever one sows.

4.g: ਗੁਰਮਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਸਕੀਣੀ ॥੨॥
4.t: gurmakh sukh fal hai masakeenee ||2||
4.e: Gurmukhs (in their humility like the earth) get fruit of delight.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
4.t: pauRee 3 : charanaa(n) dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
4.e: Example of feet

4.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਖੇਹ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਲਈ ਨਕੀਬੀ।
4.t: maanas dheh su kheh hai tis vich jeebhai liee nakeebee|
4.e: Human body is like ashes but in it the tongue is admirable (for its benefits).

4.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੰਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਰਕੀਬੀ।
4.t: akhee dhekhan roop ra(n)g raag naadh ka(n)n karan rakeebee|
4.e: The eyes behold forms and colours and the ears take care of the sounds- musical and otherwise.

4.g: ਨਕਿ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਬੁਰੀ ਤਰਤੀਬੀ।
4.t: nak suvaas nivaas hai pa(n)je dhoot buree tarateebee|
4.e: Nose is the abode of smell and thus all these five couriers (of the body) remain indulged in these pleasures (and become futile).

4.g: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਸੀਬੁ ਨਸੀਬੀ।
4.t: sabh dhoo(n) neeve charan hoi aap gavai naseeb naseebee|
4.e: Among these all, the feet are placed at the lowest level and they repudiating ego are fortunate.

4.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਬੀਬੀ।
4.t: haumai rog miTaidhaa satigur pooraa karai tabeebee|
4.e: The true Guru by giving treatment removes the malady of ego.

4.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨੀਬੀ।
4.t: pairee pai raharaas kar gur sikh sun gursikh maneebee|
4.e: The true disciples of the Guru touch the feet and bow and abide by the instructions of the Guru.

4.g: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ॥੩॥
4.t: muradhaa hoi mureedh gareebee ||3||
4.e: He who becomes humble and dead to all desires is the true disciple.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪ : ਚੀਚੀ ਅੰਗੁਲੀ ਆਦਿ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
4.t: pauRee 4 : cheechee a(n)gulee aadh dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
4.e: Example of the little finger

4.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੀਚੁੰਗਲੀ ਪੈਧੀ ਛਾਪਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
4.t: lahuRee hoi cheechu(n)galee paidhee chhaap milee vaddiaaiee|
4.e: The smallest finger is respected and adorned by making it wear the ring.

4.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਿਪ ਸਮਾਈ।
4.t: lahuRee ghanahar boo(n)dh hui paragaT motee sip samaiee|
4.e: The drop from the cloud is small but the same but getting into the mouth of shell becomes pearl.

4.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਬੂਟੀ ਕੇਸਰੈ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ।
4.t: lahuRee booTee kesarai mathai Tikaa sobhaa paiee|
4.e: The plant of saffron (Messua ferria) is small one but the same adorns the forehead in the form of consecratory mark.

4.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰੀ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਵਾਈ।
4.t: lahuRee paaras patharee asaT dhaat ka(n)chan karavaiee|
4.e: The  philosopher’s stone is small but transforms alloy of eighty metals into gold.

4.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਣਿ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੁਕਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਲੋਕ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
4.t: jiau man lahuRe sap sir dhekhai luk luk lok lukaiee|
4.e: In the head of small snake remains the jewel which people behold in wonder.

4.g: ਜਾਣਿ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪਾਰਿਅਹੁ ਰਤੀ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਜਇ ਮੁਲਾਈ।
4.t: jaan rasain paariahu ratee mul na ji mulaiee|
4.e: From mercury is prepared elixir which is invaluable.

4.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
4.t: aap gavai na aap ganaiee ||4||
4.e: Those who eschew  ego never allow themselves to be noticed.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਅੱਗ ਅਤੇ ਜਲ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ
4.t: pauRee 5 : a'g ate jal to(n) ni(n)mrataa
4.e: Humility from fire and water

4.g: ਅਗਿ ਤਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਸੀਅਰਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ।
4.t: ag tatee jal seearaa kit avagun kit gun veechaaraa|
4.e: It is a matter worth pondering as to how fire is hot and water cold.

4.g: ਅਗੀ ਧੂਆ ਧਉਲਹਰੁ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੁਚਾਰਾ।
4.t: agee dhooaa dhaulahar jal niramal gur giaan suchaaraa|
4.e: The fire soiles the building by its smoke and water cleanses it. This fact requires the guidance of Guru.

4.g: ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹੁ ਜਲ ਕੁਲ ਕਵਲੁ ਵਡੇ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ।
4.t: kul dheepak baisa(n)tarahu jal kul kaval vadde paravaaraa|
4.e: In the family and dynasty of fire is lamp, and to water belongs a bigger family of lotus.

4.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਤੰਗ ਦਾ ਕਵਲ ਭਵਰ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ।
4.t: dheepak het pata(n)g dhaa kaval bhavar paragaT paahaaraa|
4.e: This is well known all over the world that moth loves fire (and gets burnt) and black bee loves lotus (and rests in it).

4.g: ਅਗੀ ਲਾਟ ਉਚਾਟ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕੁਚਾਰਾ।
4.t: agee laaT uchaaT hai sir uchaa kar karai kuchaaraa|
4.e: The flame of fire goes up and like an egotist behaves viciously.

4.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਨੀਵਾ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ।
4.t: sir neevaa neevaan vaas paanee a(n)dhar paraupakaaraa|
4.e: Water goes towards low level and has qualities of altruism.

4.g: ਨਿਵ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੫॥
4.t: niv chalai so guroo piaaraa ||5||
4.e: The Guru loves him who remains humble by nature.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਮਜੀਠ ਕਸੁੰਭੇ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
4.t: pauRee 6 : majeeTh kasu(n)bhe to(n) upadhesh
4.e: Teaching from madder Rubia munjista and safflower-

4.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ ਕਚਾ ਪਕਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
4.t: ra(n)g majeeTh kasu(n)bh dhaa kachaa pakaa kit veechaare|
4.e: Why madder is the fast colour and safflower temporary.

4.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਖਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ਮੂਲ ਮਜੀਠ ਜੜੀ ਜੜਤਾਰੇ।
4.t: dharatee ukhan kaddeeaai mool majeeTh jaRee jaRataare|
4.e: The roots of madder spread in earth, it is first brought out and put into the pit and is pounded with wooden pestles.

4.g: ਉਖਲ ਮੁਹਲੇ ਕੁਟੀਐ ਪੀਹਣਿ ਪੀਸੈ ਚਕੀ ਭਾਰੇ।
4.t: aukhal muhale kuTeeaai peehan peesai chakee bhaare|
4.e: Then it is crushed into a heavy mill.

4.g: ਸਹੈ ਅਵੱਟਣੁ ਅੱਗਿ ਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
4.t: sahai ava'Tan a'g dhaa hoi piaaree milai piaare|
4.e: It further suffers the pain of getting boiled and decorated in water and then only it adorns (with fast colour) the clothes of the beloved.

4.g: ਪੋਹਲੀਅਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਕੈ ਫੁਲੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਚਲੁੰਭ ਖਿਲਾਰੇ।
4.t: pohaleeahu sir kadd kai ful kasu(n)bh chalu(n)bh khilaare|
4.e: The safflower comes up from the upper portion of the thorny weed Carthamus tinctoria and yields its deep colour.

4.g: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਦੇ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਹ ਚਾਰੇ।
4.t: khaT turasee dhe ra(n)geeaai kapaT saneh rahai dheh chaare|
4.e: Adding tart in it, the clothes are dyed and they remain dyed only for a few days.

4.g: ਨੀਵਾ ਜਿਣੈ ਉਚੇਰਾ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
4.t: neevaa jinai ucheraa haare ||6||
4.e: The lowly born utimately wins and the so-called high up gets defeated.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਕੀੜੀ ਮੱਕੜੀ ਆਦਿ
4.t: pauRee 7 : keeRee ma'kaRee aadh
4.e: Ant, spider etc.-

4.g: ਕੀੜੀ ਨਿਕੜੀ ਚਲਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ।
4.t: keeRee nikaRee chalit kar bhira(n)gee no mil bhira(n)gee hovai|
4.e: Small ant becomes bhringi ( a kind of buzzing bee) by keeping company with it.

4.g: ਨਿਕੜੀ ਦਿਸੈ ਮਕੜੀ ਸੂਤੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੰਗੋਵੈ।
4.t: nikaRee dhisai makaRee soot muhahu kadd fir sa(n)govai|
4.e: Apparently, the spider looks to be small but it brings out and  swallows (hundred metres of) yarn.

4.g: ਨਿਕੜੀ ਮਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਾਖਿਓ ਮਿਠਾ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਵੈ।
4.t: nikaRee makh vakhaaneeaai maakhio miThaa bhaagaTh hovai|
4.e: Honey-bee is small one but its sweet honey is sold by merchants.

4.g: ਨਿਕੜਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਟ ਪਟੋਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਢੰਗ ਢੋਵੈ।
4.t: nikaRaa keeRaa aakheeaai paT paTole kar dda(n)g ddovai|
4.e: Silk worm is little one but the clothes made by its fibre are worn and offered on the occassions of marriage and other ceremonies.

4.g: ਗੁਟਕਾ ਮੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵੈ।
4.t: guTakaa muh vich pai kai dhes dhisa(n)tar jai khaRovai|
4.e: Yogis putting the small magic ball in their mouth become invisible and go in the far off places undetected.

4.g: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਿਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਲੈ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਵੈ।
4.t: motee maanak heeriaa paatisaahu lai haar parovai|
4.e: Strings of small pearls and gems are worn by kings and emperors.

4.g: ਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਦਹੀ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
4.t: pai samain dhahee bilovai ||7||
4.e: Further, the curd is made by mixing a small quantity of rennet into milk (and thus butter is obtained).

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਘਾਹ
4.t: pauRee 8 : ghaah
4.e: Grass

4.g: ਲਤਾਂ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ ਘਾਹੁ ਨ ਕਢੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ।
4.t: lataa(n) heTh lataaReeaai ghaahu na kaddai saahu vichaaraa|
4.e: Grass is trampled under feet yet the poor thing never complains.

4.g: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਗਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ।
4.t: goras dhe khaR khai kai gai gareebee paraupakaaraa|
4.e: The cow while eating grass remains altruist and gives milk to the poor.

4.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਜਮਾਈਐ ਦਈਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਛਾਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
4.t: dhudhahu dhahee jamaieeaai dhieeahu makhan chhaeh piaaraa|
4.e: From milk is made curd and then from curd butter and delicious butter-milk etc are prepared.

4.g: ਘਿਅ ਤੇ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਢੰਗ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰਾ।
4.t: ghia te hovan hom jag dda(n)g suaarath chaj achaaraa|
4.e: With that butter (ghee) homs, yajnas and other social and religious rituals are performed.

4.g: ਧਰਮ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਧੀਰਜਿ ਵਹੈ ਸਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ।
4.t: dharam dhaul paragaT hoi dheeraj vahai sahai sir bhaaraa|
4.e: Dharma in the form of mythological bull patiently bears and burden of the earth.

4.g: ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਉ ਜਣੇਦਿਆਂ ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਗ ਹਜਾਰਾ।
4.t: eik ik jaau janedhiaa(n) chahu chakaa vich vag hajaaraa|
4.e: Each calf produces thousands of calves in all lands.

4.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
4.t: tiran a(n)dhar vaddaa paasaaraa ||8||
4.e: One blade of grass has infinite extension i.e.the humility becomes base of the whole world.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਤਿਲ
4.t: pauRee 9 : til
4.e: sesame - Sesamum indicum

4.g: ਲਹੁੜਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
4.t: lahuRaa til hoi ja(n)miaa neechahu neech na aap ganaiaa|
4.e: Small sesame seeds sprouted and it remained lowly and got itself not mentioned anywhere.

4.g: ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
4.t: fulaa sa(n)gat vasiaa hoi niraga(n)dh suga(n)dh suhaiaa|
4.e: When it came to the company of flowers, it earlier being devoid of fragrance now become fragrant.

4.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਫੁਲੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
4.t: koloo pai peeRaiaa hoi fulel khel varataiaa|
4.e: When alongwith flowers it was crushed in crusher, it became perfume oil.

4.g: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
4.t: patit pavitr chalitr kar patisaeh sir dhar sukh paiaa|
4.e: God, the purifier of the impure ones, enacted such a wondrous feat that that fragrant oil gave  pleasure to the king when messaged on his head.

4.g: ਦੀਵੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
4.t: dheevai pai jalaiaa kul dheepak jag biradh sadhaiaa|
4.e: When it was burnt in the lamp it came to be known as kuldipak, the lamp of the dynasty generally lit to complete the last rites of man.

4.g: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਵਿਅਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
4.t: kajal hoaa dheeviahu akhee a(n)dhar jai samaiaa|
4.e: From lamp becoming collyrium it merged in the eyes.

4.g: ਬਾਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
4.t: baalaa hoi na vaddaa kahaiaa ||9||
4.e: It became great but never allowed itself to be called so.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਵੜੇਵਾਂ
4.t: pauRee 10 : vaRevaa(n)
4.e: Cotton seed

4.g: ਹੋਇ ਵੜੇਵਾਂ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇਆ।
4.t: hoi vaRevaa(n) jag vich beeje tan kheh naal ralaiaa|
4.e: The cotton seed got itself mixed with dust.

4.g: ਬੂਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਹ ਦੀ ਟੀਂਡੇ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਆਪੁ ਖਿੜਾਇਆ।
4.t: booTee hoi kapaeh dhee Tee(n)dde has has aap khiRaiaa|
4.e: From that very seed the plant of cotton emerged on which the balls smiled unobstructed.

4.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਵੇਲਣੁ ਵੇਲਿਆ ਲੂੰ ਲੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਤੁੰਬੁ ਤੁੰਬਾਇਆ।
4.t: dhuh mil velan veliaa loo(n) loo(n) kar tu(n)b tu(n)baiaa|
4.e: The cotton got ginned by the ginning machine and after carding.

4.g: ਪਿੰਞਣਿ ਪਿੰਞ ਉਡਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋੜੀ ਸੂਤ ਕਤਾਇਆ।
4.t: pi(n)n(j)n pi(n)n(j) uddaiaa kar kar goRee soot kataiaa|
4.e: Making rolls and spinning, the thread was made from it.

4.g: ਤਣਿ ਵੁਣਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੁਆਇ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ।
4.t: tan vun khu(n)b chaRai kai dhe dhe dhukh dhuaai ra(n)gaiaa|
4.e: Then through its warp and waft it was woven and made to suffer getting dyed in boiling cauldron.

4.g: ਕੈਚੀ ਕਟਣਿ ਕਟਿਆ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੀਵਾਇਆ।
4.t: kaichee kaTan kaTiaa sooiee dhaage joR seevaiaa|
4.e: The scissors cut it and it was stiched with the help of needle and thread.

4.g: ਲੱਜਣੁ ਕੱਜਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
4.t: la'jan ka'jan hoi kajaiaa ||10||
4.e: Thus it became cloth, the means for the covering up of others' nudity.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਅਨਾਰਦਾਣਾ
4.t: pauRee 11 : anaaradhaanaa
4.e: Seed of the sour pomergranate

4.g: ਦਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਰ ਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੱਸੈ।
4.t: dhaanaa hoi anaar dhaa hoi dhooR dhooRee vich dha'sai|
4.e: The seed of promegranate merges into dust by becoming dust.

4.g: ਹੋਇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ਫਲ ਵਿਗੱਸੈ।
4.t: hoi birakh hareeaavalaa laal gulaalaa fal viga'sai|
4.e: The same becoming green is adorned by flowers of deep red colour.

4.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਹਸ ਫੁਲ ਫੁਲ ਫਲ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕ ਸਰੱਸੈ।
4.t: eikat birakh sahas ful ful fal ik dhoo ik sara'sai|
4.e: On a tree, thousands of fruits grow, each fruit being more delicious than another.

4.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਦਾਣੇ ਲਖ ਹੋਇ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੱਸੈ।
4.t: eik dhoo dhaane lakh hoi fal fal dhe man a(n)dhar va'sai|
4.e: In each fruit reside thousands of seeds produced by one seed.

4.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰੱਸੈ।
4.t: tis fal toT na aaviee gurmukh sukh fal a(n)mrit ra'sai|
4.e: As there is no dearth of fruit on that tree so the gurmukh is never at loss to realize the delights of the fruits of nectar.

4.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਲੱਯਨਿ ਤੋੜਿ ਫਲਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰ ਫਲੀਐ ਹੱਸੈ।
4.t: jiau jiau la'yan toR fal tiau tiau fir fir faleeaai ha'sai|
4.e: With the plucking of the fruit the tree again and again, bursting into laughter bears more fruits.

4.g: ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੱਸੈ ॥੧੧॥
4.t: niv chalan gur maarag dha'sai ||11||
4.e: Thus the great Guru teaches the way of humility.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਮੋਹਰ
4.t: pauRee 12 : shu'dh mohar
4.e: The pure coin

4.g: ਰੇਣਿ ਰਸਾਇਣ ਸਿਝੀਐ ਰੇਤੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਵਸੈ।
4.t: ren rasain sijheeaai ret het kar ka(n)chan vasai|
4.e: The dust of sand in which remains gold mixed is kept in a chemical.

4.g: ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਕਣੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਰਤੀ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲਾ ਹਸੈ।
4.t: dhoi dhoi kan kaddeeaai ratee maasaa tolaa hasai|
4.e: Then after washing the gold particles are taken out of it which weigh from miligrams to grams and more.

4.g: ਪਾਇ ਕੁਠਾਲੀ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਰੈਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਨਿਆਰਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ।
4.t: pai kuThaalee gaaleeaai rainee kar suniaar vigasai|
4.e: Then put into the crucible it is melted and to the delight of the goldsmith, is converted into lumps.

4.g: ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਲੂਣੀ ਲਾਇ ਜਲਾਇ ਰਹਸੈ।
4.t: ghaR ghaR patr pakhaaleean loonee lai jalai rahasai|
4.e: He makes leaves out of it and using chemicals washes it happily.

4.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਲਗੈ ਲਵੈ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਕਸੈ।
4.t: baareh va(n)nee hoi kai lagai lavai kasauTee kasai|
4.e: Then transformed into pure gold it becomes nimble and worthy of the test by touchstone.

4.g: ਟਕਸਾਲੈ ਸਿਕਾ ਪਵੈ ਘਣ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਚਲੁ ਸਰਸੈ।
4.t: Takasaalai sikaa pavai ghan aharan vich achal sarasai|
4.e: Now in the mint, it is moulded into a coin and remains happy on the anvil even under the strokes of hammer.

4.g: ਸਾਲੁ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਪੋਤੈ ਪਸੈ ॥੧੨॥
4.t: saal sunieeaa potai pasai ||12||
4.e: Then becoming pure muhar, a gold coin, it gets deposited into treasury i.e.the gold which was in the dust particles because of its humility, ultimately turns out to be a coin of the treasure house.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਖਸਖਾਸ ਦਾਣਾ
4.t: pauRee 13 : khasakhaas dhaanaa
4.e: The poppy seed

4.g: ਖਸਖਸ ਦਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਾਕ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਖਾਕ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
4.t: khasakhas dhaanaa hoi kai khaak a(n)dhar hoi khaak samaavai|
4.e: Mixing with dust the poppy seed becomes one with dust.

4.g: ਦੋਸਤੁ ਪੋਸਤੁ ਬੂਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ਫੱੁਲ ਖਿੜਾਵੈ।
4.t: dhosat posat booT hoi ra(n)g bira(n)gee fa'ul khiRaavai|
4.e: Becoming a lovely poppy plant it blossoms with variegated flowers.

4.g: ਹੋਡਾ ਹੋਡੀ ਡੋਡੀਆ ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਇਕ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
4.t: hoddaa hoddee ddoddeeaa ik dhoo(n) ik chaRhaau chaRhaavai|
4.e: Its flower buds vie with one another to look beautiful.

4.g: ਸੂਲੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਪਿਛੋਂ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰਾਵੈ।
4.t: soolee upar khelanaa pichho(n) dhe sir chhatr dharaavai|
4.e: First that poppy suffers on a long thorn but afterwards becoming circular assumes the shape of canopy.

4.g: ਚੁਖੁ ਚੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਹੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵੈ।
4.t: chukh chukh hoi malai kai lohoo paanee ra(n)g ra(n)gaavai|
4.e: Getting sliced it oozes its sap of the colour of blood.

4.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਮਜਲਸੀ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਬਣਾਵੈ।
4.t: piram piaalaa majalasee jog bhog sa(n)jog banaavai|
4.e: Then in the parties, becoming the cup of love, it becomes the cause of joining of bhog, enjoyment, with the yoga.

4.g: ਅਮਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਜਲਸ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
4.t: amalee hoi su majalas aavai ||13||
4.e: Its addicts come to parties to sip it.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਕਮਾਦ
4.t: pauRee 14 : kamaadh
4.e: Sugarcane

4.g: ਰਸ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਅਣੁਬੋਲਣ ਅਭਿਰਿਠਾ।
4.t: ras bhariaa ras rakhadhaa bolan anubolan abhiriThaa|
4.e: Full of juice (sugarcane) is tasty and whether it speaks or not, in both the conditions, it is sweet.

4.g: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਅਣਸੁਣਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਅਣਡਿਠਾ।
4.t: suniaa anasuniaa karai kare veechaar ddiThaa anaddiThaa|
4.e: It listens not to what is said and sees not what is visible, i.e. in the sugarcane field one neither can listen to other nor a person  is visible in it.

4.g: ਅਖੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਟਾਈਆ ਅਖੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ।
4.t: akhee dhooR aTaieeaa akhee vich a(n)goor bahiThaa|
4.e: When in the form of seed the nodes of sugarcane are put into the earth, they sprout up.

4.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਬੂਟ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਇਠਹੁ ਇਠਾ।
4.t: eik dhoo baahale booT hoi sir talavaiaa iThahu iThaa|
4.e: From one sugarcane grow many a plant, each lovely from top to bottom.

4.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਟੋਟੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਇਤੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਮਿਠਾ।
4.t: dhuh khu(n)ddaa vich peeReeaai ToTe laahe it gun miThaa|
4.e: It is crushed between two cylinderical rollers because of its sweet juice.

4.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਣਿਠਾ।
4.t: veeh ikeeh varatadhaa avaguniaare paap paniThaa|
4.e: Worthy people use it on auspicious days whereas the wicked also use it (by preparing wine etc out of it) and get perished.

4.t: ma(n)nai ga(n)nai vaa(n)g sudhiThaa ||14||
4.e: Those who cultivated the nature of sugarcane i.e. do not  shed sweetness though in peril, are indeed steadfast persons.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ ਸਿੱਪ
4.t: pauRee 15 : savaiaa(n)tee boo(n)dh te si'p
4.e: The svati drop and the shell

4.g: ਘਣਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਨੀਵੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਾਸਹੁ ਆਵੈ।
4.t: ghanahar boo(n)dh suhaavanee neevee hoi agaasahu aavai|
4.e: A lovely drop of cloud falls from the sky and mitigating its ego goes into  the mouth of a shell in sea.

4.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਿਪੈ ਦੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
4.t: aap gavai samu(n)dh vekh sipai dhe muh vich samaavai|
4.e: The shell, at once, closing its mouth dives down and hides itself in the underworld.

4.g: ਲੈਦੋ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿਪੁ ਚੁੰਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਲੁਕਾਵੈ।
4.t: laidho hee muh boo(n)dh sip chu(n)bhee maar pataal lukaavai|
4.e: The shell, at once, closing its mouth dives down and hides itself in the underworld.

4.g: ਫੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਮਰੁਜੀਵੜਾ ਪਰ ਕਾਰਜ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਫੜਾਵੈ।
4.t: faR kaddai marujeevaRaa par kaaraj no aap faRaavai|
4.e: The diver catches hold of it and it  also allows itself to be caught for the sale of altruistic sense.

4.g: ਪਰਵਸਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨੋ ਪਰ ਹਥਿ ਪਥਰ ਦੰਦ ਭਨਾਵੈ।
4.t: paravas paraupakaar no par hath pathar dha(n)dh bhanaavai|
4.e: Controlled by  the sense of benevolence it gets itself broken on stone.

4.g: ਭੁਲਿ ਅਭੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੇ ਮੋਤੀ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ।
4.t: bhul abhul amul dhe motee dhaan na pachhotaavai|
4.e: Knowing well or  unknowingly it bestows a free gift and never repents.

4.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੋਈ ਵਰੁਸਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥
4.t: safal janam koiee varusaavai ||15||
4.e: Any rare one gets  such a blest life.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਹੀਰੇ ਕਣੀ ਤੋਂ ਸਿੱਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਮੇਲ
4.t: pauRee 16 : heere kanee to(n) si'kh guroo dhaa mel
4.e: Diamond-bit and Sikh of the Guru

4.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧੀਐ ਬਰਮੇ ਕਣੀ ਅਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਹੀਰੈ।
4.t: heere heeraa bedheeaai barame kanee anee hoi heerai|
4.e: With diamond-bit of drill the piece of diamond is cut gradually i.e. with the  diamond bit of the Word of the Guru the mind-diamond is pierced.

4.g: ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੋਈਐ ਹੀਰੈ ਮਾਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗਹੀਰੈ।
4.t: dhaagaa hoi paroieeaai heerai maal rasaal gaheerai|
4.e: With  the thread (of love) a beautiful string of diamonds is prepared.

4.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੈ।
4.t: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv haumai maar marai man dheerai|
4.e: In the holy  congregation, merging consciousness in the Word and eschewing ego, the  mind is tranquilized.

4.g: ਮਨ ਜਿਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਰੀਰੈ।
4.t: man jin man dhe le man gun vich gun gurmukh sareerai|
4.e: Conquering the mind, one should surrender it (before the Guru) and adopt the virtues of gurmukhs, the Guru oriented ones.

4.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਣੁ ਨ ਨੀਰੈ।
4.t: pairee pai paa khaak hoi kaamadhen sa(n)t ren na neerai|
4.e: He  ought to fall on the feet of saints because even the wish-granting cow  (Kamadhenu) is not equal to the dust of the feet of saints.

4.g: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਤਰਸਨ ਸੀਰੈ।
4.t: silaa aloonee chaTanee lakh a(n)mirat ras tarasan seerai|
4.e: This act is  nothing but licking of the tasteless stone though myriad tastes of sweet  juices one strives for.

4.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧੬॥
4.t: viralaa sikh sunai gur peerai ||16||
4.e: Rare is the Sikh who listens to (and accepts) the  teachings of the Guru.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੀ ਕਰਨੀ
4.t: pauRee 17 : jeevan mukat dhee karanee
4.e: The conduct of the liberated one

4.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੋਲਾ।
4.t: gur sikhee gursikh sun a(n)dhar siaanaa baahar bholaa|
4.e: Listening to the teachings of the Guru, the Sikh becomes wise internally though apparently he looks a simpleton.

4.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬੋਲਾ।
4.t: sabadh surat saavadhaan hoi vin gur sabadh na suniee bolaa|
4.e: He with full care keeps his  consciousness attuned to the Word and listens to nothing except the words  of Guru.

4.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਖੋਲਾ।
4.t: satigur dharasan dhekhanaa saadhasa(n)gat vin a(n)nhaa kholaa|
4.e: He beholds the true Guru and without the company of the saints  feels himself blind and deaf.

4.g: ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਚੁਪਿ ਚਬੋਲਾ।
4.t: vaahaguroo gur sabadh lai piram piaalaa chup chabolaa|
4.e: The Guru's word he receives is Vahiguru, the  wondrous Lord, and remains silently immersed in delight.

4.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਚਰਣਿ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਝੋਲਾ।
4.t: pairee pai paa khaak hoi charan dhoi charanodhak jholaa|
4.e: He bows on the  feet and becoming (humble) like dust goes on quaffing the nectar of the feet  (of the Lord).

4.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ।
4.t: charan kaval chit bhavar kar bhavajal a(n)dhar rahai nirolaa|
4.e: He remains involved like black bee in the lotus feet (of the  Guru) and thus living in this world ocean remains unsmeared (by its water  and dust).

4.g: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧੭॥
4.t: jeevan mukat sachaavaa cholaa ||17||
4.e: His is life of a liberated one during the life on earth i.e. he is a  jivanmukt'.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਵਾਲ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
4.t: pauRee 18 : vaal dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
4.e: Example of hair

4.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਕੈ ਵਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਢਾਲੈ।
4.t: sir vich nikai vaal hoi saadhoo charan chavar kar ddaalai|
4.e: Preparing the whisk of even the hair of one's head (the gurmukh) one should  wave it on the feet of the saints i.e. he should be extremely humble.

4.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਅੰਝੂ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪੈਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੈ।
4.t: gur sar teerath nai kai a(n)jhoo bhar bhar pair pakhaalai|
4.e: Bathing  in the pilgrimage place, he should wash the feet of the Guru with tears of  love.

4.g: ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਚਲਣ ਜਾਣਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੈ।
4.t: kaalee hoo(n) dhaule kare chalan jaan neesaan samhaalai|
4.e: From black, his hair may turn grey but then considering his time to  go (from this world) he should cherish in his heart the symbol (love) of the  Lord.

4.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੈ।
4.t: pairee pai paa khaak hoi pooraa satigur nadhar nihaalai|
4.e: When one, falling at the Guru's feet, becomes dust himself, i.e. totally deletes ego from his mind, the true Guru also then blesses and obliges  him.

4.g: ਕਾਗ ਕੁਮੰਤਹੁੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਖਾਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ।
4.t: kaag kuma(n)tahu(n) param ha(n)s ujal motee khai khavaalai|
4.e: He should become swan and leave black wisdom of crow and should  himself perform and get others perform pearl-like invaluable deeds.

4.g: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਾਲੈ।
4.t: vaalahu nikee aakheeaai gur sikhee sun gursikh paalai|
4.e: The  teachings of the Guru are subtler even than the hair itself; the Sikh should  always follow them.

4.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ॥੧੮॥
4.t: gursikh la(n)ghai piram piaalai ||18||
4.e: The Sikhs of the Guru go across the world-ocean by  virtue of their cup full of love.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਗੁਲ੍ਹਰ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
4.t: pauRee 19 : gulhar dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
4.e: Example of a wild fig tree

4.g: ਗੁਲਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੁਣਹਣਾ ਗੁਲਰ ਨੋਂ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
4.t: gular a(n)dhar bhunahanaa gular no(n) brahama(n)dd vakhaanai|
4.e: Fig is the cosmos for the insect living in it.

4.g: ਗੁਲਰ ਲਗਣਿ ਲਖ ਫਲ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਲਖ ਅਲਖ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
4.t: gular lagan lakh fal ik dhoo lakh alakh na jaanai|
4.e: But on a tree grows millions of fruits which multiply further in numberless quantity.

4.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਗੀਚਿਅਹੁ ਲਖ ਬਗੀਚੇ ਬਾਗ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
4.t: lakh lakh birakh bageechiahu lakh bageeche baag vakhaanai|
4.e: Gardens are there of  myriad trees and likewise are millions of gardens in the world.

4.g: ਲਖ ਬਾਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਲੂਅ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।
4.t: lakh baag brahama(n)dd vich lakh brahama(n)dd looa vich aanai|
4.e: Millions of  universes are there in one small hair of God.

4.g: ਮਿਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
4.t: mihar kare je miharavaan gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat ra(n)g maanai|
4.e: If that kind God showers His  grace, only then a gurmukh can enjoy the delight of the holy congregation.

4.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਚਲੈ ਓਹੁ ਭਾਣੈ।
4.t: pairee pai paa khaak hoi saahib dhe chalai oh bhaanai|
4.e: Only then falling on the feet and becoming dust, the humble one can mould  himself according to the divine Will (hukam) of the Lord.

4.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੧੯॥
4.t: haumai jai ta jai sin(j)aanai ||19||
4.e: Only when ego is  erased, this fact is realized and identified.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਦੂਜ ਦੇ ਚੰਦ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
4.t: pauRee 20 : dhooj dhe cha(n)dh to(n) upadhesh
4.e: Lesson from moon of the second phase

4.g: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਹਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਲੋਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਤੀਐ ਦਿਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਕਾ।
4.t: dhui dheh cha(n)dh alop hoi teeaai dheh chaRhadhaa hoi nikaa|
4.e: Remaining invisible for two days, third day the moon is beholden in a small  size.

4.g: ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੁਹਾਰਦਾ ਗਗਨ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਟਿਕਾ।
4.t: auTh uTh jagat juhaaradhaa gagan mahesur masatak Tikaa|
4.e: Supposed to adorn the forehead of Mahesa, people bow to it again  and again.

4.g: ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੀਐ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਇਕਾ।
4.t: soleh kalaa sa(n)ghaareeaai safal janam sohai kal ikaa|
4.e: When it has attained all the sixteen phases i.e. on the full moon night, it begins diminishing and again reaches the position of the first day. People now bow before it.

4.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਿੰਜੈ ਸਹਸਿਕਾ।
4.t: a(n)mirat kiran suhaavanee nijhar jharai si(n)jai sahasikaa|
4.e: Nectar is sprinkled by its rays and it irrigates  all thirsty trees and fields.

4.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮਿਕਾ।
4.t: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh dhe sahaj sa(n)jogee ratan amikaa|
4.e: Peace, contentment and cool, these invaluable  jewels are bestowed by it.

4.g: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰਹੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਡੋਰ ਚਕੋਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਛਿਕਾ।
4.t: karai anerahu chaananaa ddor chakor dhiaan dhar chhikaa|
4.e: In darkness, it spreads light and provides the  thread of meditation to the chakor, the redlegged partridge.

4.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਅਮੋਲ ਮਣਿਕਾ ॥੨੦॥
4.t: aap gavai amol manikaa ||20||
4.e: Only by erasing  its ego it becomes an invaluable jewel.

4.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧ : ਧ੍ਰੂ ਭਗਤ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
4.t: pauRee 21 : dhraoo bhagat dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
4.e: Dhruv, the humble one

4.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
4.t: hoi nimaanaa bhagat kar gurmukh dhraoo har dharasan paiaa|
4.e: By becoming humble only, Dhru could behold the Lord.

4.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਆਪ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ।
4.t: bhagat vachhal hoi bheTiaa maan nimaane aap dhivaiaa|
4.e: God, affectionate  to the devotees, also embraced him and egoless Dhruv attained the highest  glory.

4.g: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ।
4.t: maat lok vich mukat kar nihachal vaas agaas chaRaiaa|
4.e: In this mortal world he was granted liberation and then a stable  place in the sky was given him.

4.g: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ।
4.t: cha(n)dh sooraj tetees karoR paradhakhanaa chaufer firaiaa|
4.e: Moon, sun and all the thirty three crores of angels circumambulate and revolve around him.

4.g: ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
4.t: vedh puraan vakhaanadhe paragaT kar parataap janaiaa|
4.e: His magnificence has  been clearly described in the Vedas and Puranas.

4.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
4.t: abigat gat at agam hai akath kathaa veechaar na aaiaa|
4.e: The story of that  unmanifest Lord is extremely mystical, indescribable and beyond all  thoughts.

4.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੪॥
4.t: gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhaiaa ||21||4||
4.e: Only gurmukhs can have a glimpse of Him.

5.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
5.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
5.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

5.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣ
5.t: pauRee 1 : gurmukhaa(n) dhe la'chhan
5.e: Attributes of gurmukhs - the guru oriented

5.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਚੈ।
5.t: gurmukh hovai saadhasa(n)g horat sa(n)g kusa(n)g na rachai|
5.e: The person having attained the status of Gurmukh in the holy  congregation does not mix up with any bad company.

5.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਖੇਚਲ ਖਚੈ।
5.t: gurmukh pa(n)th suhelaRaa baareh pa(n)th na khechal khachai|
5.e: The way (life) of  Gurmukh is simple and enjoyable; he does not enrapt himself with the  concerns of the twelve sects (of yogis).
