10.t: pichhahu raaje sadhiaa abichal raaj karahu nit neetaa|
10.e: (After some time) King (Uttanpad) called him back and asked him (Dhru) to rule forever.

10.g: ਹਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
10.t: haar chale gurmukh jag jeetaa ||1||
10.e: The gurmukhs who seem to be losing i.e. who turn their faces from the evil propensities, conquer the world.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 2 : prahalaadh bhagat
10.e: Prahlad

10.g: ਘਰਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਦੈਤ ਦੇ ਕਲਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ।
10.t: ghar haranaakhas dhait dhe kalar kaval bhagat prahilaadhu|
10.e: Prahlad, the saint, was born in the house of demon (king) Haranakhas like a lotus is born in the alkaline (barren) land.

10.g: ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ ਪਾਂਧੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੋਆ ਅਹਿਲਾਦੁ।
10.t: paRhan paThaiaa chaaTasaal paa(n)dhe chit hoaa ahilaadhu|
10.e: When he was sent to seminary, the brahmin purohit became elated (because the king’s son was now his disciple).

10.g: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਾਦੁ।
10.t: simarai man vich raam naam gaavai sabadh anaahadh naadhu|
10.e: Prahlad would remember the name of Ram in his heart and outwardly also he would eulogise the Lord.

10.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਭ ਚਾਟੜੈ ਪਾਂਧੇ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ।
10.t: bhagat karan sabh chaaTaRai paa(n)dhe hoi rahe visamaadhu|
10.e: Now all the disciples became devotees of Lord, which was an awful and embarrassing situation for all the teachers.

10.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਰੂਆਇਆ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੈਤਿ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਵਾਦੁ।
10.t: raaje paas rooaaiaa dhokhee dhait vadhaiaa vaadhu|
10.e: The priest (teacher) reported or complained to the king (that O king your son has become devotee of God).

10.g: ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਤਿਆ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ।
10.t: jal aganee vich ghatiaa jalai na ddubai gur parasaadh|
10.e: The malevolent demon picked up the quarrel. Prahlad was thrown into fire and water but with the grace of Guru (the Lord) neither he was burnt nor drowned.

10.g: ਕਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ।
10.t: kadd khaRag sadh puchhiaa kaunu su teraa hai usataadhu|
10.e: Angered as he was, Hiranyaksyapu took out his double-edged sword and asked Prahlad who his Guru (Lord) was.

10.g: ਥੰਮ੍ਹੁ ਪਾੜਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਨਾਦਿ।
10.t: tha(n)mh paaR paragaTiaa narasi(n)gh roop anoop anaadh|
10.e: At the same moment Lord God in the form of man-lion came out of pillar. His form was grand and majestic.

10.g: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ।
10.t: bemukh pakaR pachhaaRian sa(n)t sahaiee aadh jugaadh|
10.e: That wicked demon was thrown down and killed and thus it was proved that the Lord is kind to devotees since the time immemorial.

10.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ॥੨॥
10.t: jai jai kaar karan brahamaadh||2||
10.e: Seeing this Brahma and other gods started eulogising the Lord.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਰਾਜਾ ਬਲਿ
10.t: pauRee 3 : raajaa bal
10.e: Bali, the king

10.g: ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਜਗਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ।
10.t: bal raajaa ghar aapanai a(n)dhar baiThaa jag karaavai|
10.e: Bali, the king, was busy in performing a yajna in his palace.

10.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੀ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਠ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
10.t: baavan roopee aaiaa chaar vedh mukh paaTh sunaavai|
10.e: A low stature dwarf in the form of brahmin came there reciting all the four Vedas.

10.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਦਿਆ ਮੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
10.t: raaje a(n)dhar sadhiaa ma(n)g suaamee jo tudh bhaavai|
10.e: The king after calling him in asked him to demand anything he liked.

10.g: ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਣਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤੁ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ।
10.t: achhal chhalan tudh aaiaa sukr purohit keh samajhaavai|
10.e: Immediately priest Sukracharya made the king (Bali) understand that he (the beggar) is undeceivable God and He had came to delude him.

10.g: ਕਰੌ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਲੋਅ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ।
10.t: karau addaiee dharat ma(n)g pichhahu dhe tirahu loa na maavai|
10.e: The dwarf demanded two and half steps length of earth (which was granted by the king).

10.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰਵਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਅ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੈ ਮਗਰੁ ਮਿਣਾਵੈ।
10.t: dhui karavaa(n) kar ti(n)n loa bal raajaa lai magar minaavai|
10.e: Then the dwarf expanded his body so much that now the three worlds were insufficient for him.

10.g: ਬਲਿ ਛਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: bal chhal aap chhalaian hoi dhiaal milai gal laavai|
10.e: Even knowing this deception Bali allowed himself to be deceived so, and seeing this Vishnu embraced him.

10.g: ਦਿਤਾ ਰਾਜੁ ਪਤਾਲ ਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਧੀਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ।
10.t: dhitaa raaj pataal dhaa hoi adheen bhagat jas gaavai|
10.e: When he covered the three worlds in two steps, for third half-step king Bali offered his own back.

10.g: ਹੋਇ ਦਰਵਾਨ ਮਹਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
10.t: hoi dharavaan mahaa(n) sukh paavai ||3||
10.e: Bali was given the kingdom of the netherworld where surrendering to God he engaged himself in the loving devotion of the Lord. Vishnu was delighted to be the doorkeeper of Bali.

10.g: ੪ : ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਗਤੀ
10.t: 4 : a(n)bareek bhagatee
10.e: Ambaris

10.g: ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਮੁਹਿ ਵਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਪਈ ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ।
10.t: a(n)bareek muh varat hai raat piee dhurabaasaa aaiaa|
10.e: One evening while king Ambaris was fasting he was visited by sage Durvasa

10.g: ਭੀੜਾ ਓਸੁ ਉਪਾਰਣਾ ਓਹੁ ਉਠਿ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਿ ਨਦੀ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ।
10.t: bheeRaa os upaaranaa oh uTh nhaavan nadhee sidhaiaa|
10.e: The king was to break his fast while serving Durvasa but the rishi went to the riverbank to take a bath.

10.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਪੋਖਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਦੇਣ ਨੋ ਧਾਇਆ।
10.t: charanodhak lai pokhiaa oh saraap dhen no dhaiaa|
10.e: Fearing the change of date (which would deem his fast fruitless), the king broke his fast by drinking the water which he had poured on the feet of the rishi. When the rishi realised that the king had not served him first, he ran to curse the king.

10.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੁਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਾਲ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
10.t: chakr sudharasan kaal roop hoi bheehaaval garab gavaiaa|
10.e: On this, Vishnu ordered his death like disc to move towards Durvasa  and thus the ego of Durvasa was removed.

10.g: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਭੰਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਲੈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਇਆ।
10.t: baamhan bha(n)naa jeeau lai rakh na ha(n)ghan dhev sabaiaa|
10.e: Now Brahmin Durvasa ran for his life. Even the gods and deities could not afford him shelter.

10.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕੁ ਤਜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕੁ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤਜਾਇਆ।
10.t: ei(n)dhrr lok siv lok taj braham lok baiku(n)Th tajaiaa|
10.e: He was avoided in the abodes of Indra, Siva, Brahma and the heavens.

10.g: ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਸਣੁ ਸਿਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
10.t: dhevatiaa(n) bhagavaan san sikh dhei sabhanaa(n) samajhaiaa|
10.e: Gods and God made him understand (that none except Ambaris could save him).

10.g: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਾਰੀਦਾ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਛੁਡਾਇਆ।
10.t: aai piaa saranaagatee maareedhaa a(n)bareek chhuddaiaa|
10.e: Then he surrendered before Ambaris and Ambaris saved the dying sage.

10.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
10.t: bhagat vachhal jag biradh sadhaiaa ||4||
10.e: The Lord God came to be known in the world as benevolent to devotees.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਕ
10.t: pauRee 5 : raajaa janak
10.e: King Janak

10.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਵਡਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
10.t: bhagat vaddaa raajaa janak hai gurmukh maiaa vich udhaasee|
10.e: King Janak was a great saint who amidst maya remained indifferent to it.

10.g: ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕ ਨੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੁ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ।
10.t: dhev lok no chaliaa gan ga(n)dharab sabhaa sukhavaasee|
10.e: Along with gans and gandharvs (calestial musicians) he went to the abode of the gods.

10.g: ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸੁਣਿ ਵਿਲਲਾਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
10.t: jamapur giaa pukaar sun vilalaavan jeea narak nivaasee|
10.e: From there, he, hearing the cries of inhabitants of hell, went to them.

10.g: ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਆਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦ ਖਲਾਸੀ।
10.t: dharamarai no aakhion sabhanaa dhee kar ba(n)dh khalaasee|
10.e: He asked the god of death, Dharamrai, to relieve all their suffering.

10.g: ਕਰੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
10.t: kare benatee dharamarai hau sevak Thaakur abinaasee|
10.e: Hearing this, the god of death told him he was a mere servant of the eternal Lord (and without His orders he could not liberate them).

10.g: ਗਹਿਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਪਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਜਾਸੀ।
10.t: gahine dharion ik naau paapaa naal karai nirajaasee|
10.e: Janak offered a part of his devotion and remembrance of the name of the Lord.

10.g: ਪਾਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਅਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਸੀ।
10.t: paasa(n)g paap na pujanee gurmukh naau atul na tulaasee|
10.e: All the sins of hell were found not equal even to the counterweight of balance.

10.g: ਨਰਕਹੁ ਛੁਟੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਟੀ ਗਲਹੰੁ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ।
10.t: narakahu chhuTe jeea ja(n)t kaTee galaha(n) silak jam faasee|
10.e: In fact no balance can weigh the fruits of recitation and remembrance of the Lords name by the gurmukh.

10.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥
10.t: mukat jugat naavai dhee dhaasee ||5||
10.e: All the creatures got liberated from hell and the noose of death was cut.  Liberation and the technique of attaining it are the servants of the name of the Lord.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਹਰੀਚੰਦ ਤੇ ਤਾਰਾ ਰਾਣੀ
10.t: pauRee 6 : hareecha(n)dh te taaraa raanee
10.e: Harischandar and queen Taramati

10.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰੀਚੰਦ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਾ ਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਣੀ।
10.t: sukh raaje hareecha(n)dh ghar naar su taaraa lochan raanee|
10.e: King HariChand had a queen with beautiful eyes, Tara, who had made his home the abode of comforts.

10.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਣੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ।
10.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaavadhe raatee jai sunai gurbaanee|
10.e: At night she would go to the place where in the form of holy congregation, would recite the holy hymns.

10.g: ਪਿਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਅਧੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਿਖੰਡਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
10.t: pichhai raajaa jaagiaa adhee raat nikha(n)dd vihaanee|
10.e: After she had left, the King awoke in the middle of the night and realised she had gone.

10.g: ਰਾਣੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਹੈਰਾਣੀ।
10.t: raanee dhis na aaviee man vich varat giee hairaanee|
10.e: He could not find the Queen anywhere and his heart filled with astonishment

10.g: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਕੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਲ ਜੁਆਣੀ।
10.t: horat raatee uTh kai chaliaa pichhai taral juaanee|
10.e: The following night he followed the young queen.

10.g: ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹੁਤੀ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਖੜੀ ਖੜਾਉ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
10.t: raanee pahutee sa(n)gatee raaje khaRee khaRaau neesaanee|
10.e: The queen reached the holy congregation and the King lifted one of her sandals from there (so that he could prove the infidelity of the queen).

10.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੀ ਖੜਾਉ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ।
10.t: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa joRee juRee khaRaau puraanee|
10.e: When about to go, the queen concentrated upon the holy congregation and the one sandal became a pair.

10.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਏਹ ਖੜਾਵ ਹੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
10.t: raaje ddiThaa chalit ih eh khaRaav hai choj viddaanee|
10.e: The king upheld this feat and realized that there her matching sandal was a miracle.

10.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
10.t: saadhasa(n)gat viTahu kurabaanee ||6||
10.e: I am sacrifice unto the holy congregation.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਬਿਦਰ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਰਯੋਧਨ
10.t: pauRee 7 : bidhar ate dhurayodhan
10.e: Vidur and Duryodhan

10.g: ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਬਿਦਰ ਦੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੁਖਾ।
10.t: aaiaa suniaa bidhar dhe bolai dhurajodhan hoi rukhaa|
10.e: Hearing that Lord Krishan was served and stayed over at humble Bidar's home, Duryodhan remarked sarcastically.

10.g: ਘਰਿ ਅਸਾਡੇ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੋਲੇ ਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਸੁਖਾ।
10.t: ghar asaadde chhadd kai gole dhe ghar jaeh k sukhaa|
10.e: Leaving our grand palaces, how much happiness and comfort did you attain in the home of a servant?

10.g: ਭੀਖਮੁ ਦੋਣਾ ਕਰਣ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਮਾਨੁਖਾ।
10.t: bheekham dhonaa karan taj sabhaa seegaar vadde maanukhaa|
10.e: You gave up even Bhikhaum, Dohna and Karan who are recognised as great men who are adorned in all courts.

10.g: ਝੁੰਗੀ ਜਾਇ ਵਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੁਖਾ।
10.t: jhu(n)gee jai valaion sabhanaa dhe jeea a(n)dhar dhukhaa|
10.e: We have all been anguished to find that you have lived in a hut”.

10.g: ਹਸਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਜੀ ਸੁਣਿਹੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਨਮੁਖਾ।
10.t: has bolai bhagavaan jee suniho raajaa hoi sanamukhaa|
10.e: Then smilingly, Lord Krishan asked the King to come forward and to listen carefully.

10.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਪਦਾ ਦੁਖਾ।
10.t: tere bhaau na dhisiee mere naahee apadhaa dhukhaa|
10.e: I see no love and devotion in you (and hence I have not come to you).

10.g: ਭਾਉ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਬਿਦਰ ਦੇ ਹੋਰੀ ਦੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਚਾਉ ਨ ਚੁਖਾ।
10.t: bhaau jivehaa bidhar dhe horee dhe chit chaau na chukhaa|
10.e: No heart I see has even a fraction of the love that Bidar bears in his heart.

10.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਭੁਖਾ ॥੭॥
10.t: gobi(n)dh bhaau bhagat dhaa bhukhaa ||7||
10.e: The Lord needs loving devotion and nothing else.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਦਰੋਪਤੀ
10.t: pauRee 8 : dharopatee
10.e: Draupadi

10.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭਾ ਦੁਸਾਸਣੈ ਮਥੇਵਾਲਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਆਂਦੀ।
10.t: a(n)dhar sabhaa dhusaasanai mathevaal dhropatee aa(n)dhee|
10.e: Dragging Daropati by the hair, Dusasanai brought her into the assembly.

10.g: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਨੰਗੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਬਾਂਦੀ।
10.t: dhootaa no furamaiaa na(n)gee karahu pa(n)chaalee baa(n)dhee|
10.e: He commanded his men to strip the maidservant Dropati stark naked.

10.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਪਾਂਡੋ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਅਉਘਟਿ ਰੁਧੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੀ।
10.t: pa(n)je paa(n)ddo vekhadhe aaughaT rudhee naar jinaa dhee|
10.e: All the five Pandavs who she was the wife of, beheld this.

10.g: ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਦੀ।
10.t: akhee meeT dhiaan dhar haa haa kirasan karai bilalaa(n)dhee|
10.e: Crying, totally dejected and helpless, she closed her eyes. Single-mindedly she invoked Krishna for help.

10.g: ਕਪੜ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਂਦੀ।
10.t: kapaR koT usaarion thake dhoot na paar vasaa(n)dhee|
10.e: The servants were taking off the clothes from her body but more layers of clothes formed a fort around her; the servants got tired but the layers of clothes were never ending.

10.g: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜਨਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਨਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਾਂਦੀ।
10.t: hath maroRan sir dhunan pachhotaan karan jaeh jaa(n)dhee|
10.e: The servants were now writhing and frustrated on their abortive attempt and felt that they themselves were ashamed.

10.g: ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਹੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਸ਼ਰਮਾਂਦੀ।
10.t: ghar aaiee Thaakur mile paij rahee bole sharamaa(n)dhee|
10.e: On reaching home, Dropati was asked by Lord Krishna whether she was saved in the assembly.

10.g: ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥਾਂ ਬਾਣਿ ਧੁਰਾਂ ਦੀ ॥੮॥
10.t: naath anaathaa(n) baan dhuraa(n) dhee ||8||
10.e: She shyly replied, “Since perennial times you are living up to your reputation of being father of the fatherless ones.”

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 9 : sudhaamaa bhagat
10.e: Sudama

10.g: ਬਿਪੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਦਾਲਿਦੀ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਦਾਏ।
10.t: bip sudhaamaa dhaalidhee baal sakhaiee mitrr sadhaae|
10.e: Sudama, a poor brahman, was known to be a friend of Krishna from childhood.

10.g: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਦਲਿਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਗਵਾਏ।
10.t: laagoo hoiee baamhanee mil jagadhees dhalidhrr gavaae|
10.e: His brahmin wife always pestered him as to why he did not go to Lord Krishna to alleviate his poverty.

10.g: ਚਲਿਆ ਗਣਦਾ ਗਟੀਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ।
10.t: chaliaa ganadhaa gaTeeaa(n) kiau kar jaieeaai kaun milaae|
10.e: He was perplexed and pondered over how he could get re-introduced to Krishna, who could help him meet the Lord.

10.g: ਪਹੁਤਾ ਨਗਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਕਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਖਲੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ।
10.t: pahutaa nagar dhuaarakaa si(n)gh dhuaar khalotaa jaae|
10.e: He reached the town of Duaraka and stood before the main gate (of the palace of Krishna).

10.g: ਦੂਰਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਛਡਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਆਏ।
10.t: dhoorahu dhekh dda(n)ddaut kar chhadd si(n)ghaasan har jee aae|
10.e: Seeing him from a distance, Krishna, the Lord, bowed and leaving his throne came to Sudama.

10.g: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੇ ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਕੇ ਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ।
10.t: pahile dhe paradhakhanaa pairee pai ke lai gal laae|
10.e: First he circumambulated around Sudama and then touching his feet he embraced him.

10.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣੁ ਉਤੇ ਬੈਠਾਏ।
10.t: charanodhak lai pair dhoi si(n)ghaasan ute baiThaae|
10.e: Washing his feet he took that water and made Sudama sit on the throne.

10.g: ਪੁਛੇ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
10.t: puchhe kusal piaar kar gur sevaa dhee kathaa sunaae|
10.e: Then Krishna lovingly enquired about his welfare and talked about the time when they were together in the service of the guru (Sandipani).

10.g: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਚਬਿਓਨੁ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਗੈ ਪਹੁਚਾਏ।
10.t: lai kai ta(n)dhul chabion vidhaa kare agai pahuchaae|
10.e: Krishna asked for the rice sent by Sudama’s wife and after eating, came out to see off his friend Sudama.

10.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਕੁਚਿ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੯॥
10.t: chaar padhaarath sakuch paThaae ||9||
10.e: Though all the four boons (righteousness,wealth,fulfillment of desire and libereation) were given to Sudama by Krishna, Krishna's humbleness still made him feel totally helpless.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਜੈਦੇਉ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 10 : jaidheau bhagat
10.e: Jaidev

10.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕਰਿ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ।
10.t: prem bhagat jaidheau kar geet govi(n)dh sahaj dhun gaavai|
10.e: Getting immersed in the loving devotion, the devotee Jaidev would sing the songs of the Lord (Govind).

10.g: ਲੀਲਾ ਚਲਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ।
10.t: leelaa chalit vakhaanadhaa a(n)tarajaamee Thaakur bhaavai|
10.e: He would describe the glorious feats accomplished by God and was greatly loved by him.

10.g: ਅਖਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਆਵੜੈ ਪੁਸਤਕੁ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ।
10.t: akhar ik na aavaRai pusatak ba(n)neh sa(n)dhiaa kar aavai|
10.e: He (Jaidev) knew no would and hence binding his book would return home in the evening.

10.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਭਗਤ ਰੂਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਬਣਾਵੈ।
10.t: gun nidhaan ghar aai kai bhagat roop likh lekh banaavai|
10.e: God, the repository of all virtues in the form of the devotee Himself wrote all the songs for him.

10.g: ਅਖਰ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨ ਅੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
10.t: akhar paReh parateet kar hoi visamaadh na a(n)g samaavai|
10.e: Jaidev would get elated seeing and reading those words.

10.g: ਵੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਉਜਾੜਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ।
10.t: vekhai jai ujaaR vich birakh ik aacharaj suhaavai|
10.e: Jaidev saw a wonderful tree in the deep forest.

10.g: ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ।
10.t: geet govi(n)dh sa(n)poorano pat pat likhiaa a(n)t na paavai|
10.e: Each and every leaf had the songs of the Lord Govind written on it. He could not understand this mystery.

10.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: bhagat het paragaas kar hoi dhiaal milai gal laavai|
10.e: Due to the love for the devotee, God embraced him in person.

10.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਗਣਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥
10.t: sa(n)t ana(n)t na bhedh ganaavai ||10||
10.e: God and saint have no veil in between.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 11 : naamadhev bhagat
10.e: Namdev

10.g: ਕੰਮ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਿਉ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ।
10.t: ka(n)m kitai piau chaliaa naamadheau no aakh sidhaiaa|
10.e: Namdev's father was called to do some work so he called Naamdev.

10.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਵਣੁ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
10.t: Thaakur dhee sevaa karee dhudh peeaavan keh samajhaiaa|
10.e: He told Namdev to serve Thakur, the Lord, with milk.

10.g: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਪਲ ਗਾਇ ਦੁਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ।
10.t: naamadheau isanaan kar kapal gai dhuh kai lai aaiaa|
10.e: After taking bath Namdev brought the milk of black-teat cow.

10.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
10.t: Thaakur no nhaavaal kai charanodhak lai tilak chaRhaiaa|
10.e: Having bathed the Thakur, he put the water used to wash the Thakur, on his own head.

10.g: ਹਥਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ਜੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇਆ।
10.t: hath joR binatee karai dhudh peeahu jee gobi(n)dh raiaa|
10.e: Now with folded hands he requested the Lord to have milk.

10.g: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ।
10.t: nihachau kar aaraadhiaa hoi dhiaal dharas dhikhalaiaa|
10.e: Becoming steadfast in his thoughts when he prayed, the Lord appeared before him in person.

10.g: ਭਰੀ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵਿ ਲੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ।
10.t: bharee kaToree naamadhev lai Thaakur no dhudh peeaaiaa|
10.e: Namdev made Lord drink the full bowl of milk.

10.g: ਗਾਇ ਮੁਈ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਦਾ ਛਪਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
10.t: gai muiee jeevaalion naamadhev dhaa chhapar chhaiaa|
10.e: On another occasion God brought a dead cow to life and also thatched the hut of Namdev.

10.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
10.t: fer dhehuraa rakhion chaar varan lai pairee paiaa|
10.e: On yet another occasion, God rotated the temple (after Naamdev was not allowed entrance) and made all the four castes (varnas) bow at the feet of Namdev.

10.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
10.t: bhagat janaa dhaa kare karaiaa ||11||
10.e: The Lord accomplishes whatever is done and desired by saints.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਅਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ
10.t: pauRee 12 : naamadhev ate tiralochan
10.e: Namdev and Trilochan

10.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਆਵੈ।
10.t: dharasan dhekhan naamadhev bhalake uTh tiralochan aavai|
10.e: Trilochan awoke early daily just to have sight of Namdev,

10.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਇ ਜਣੇ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
10.t: bhagat karan mil dhui jane naamadheau har chalit sunaavai|
10.e: Together they would concentrate on the Lord and Namdev would tell him the grand stories of God.

10.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
10.t: meree bhee kar benatee dharasan dhekhaa(n) je tis bhaavai|
10.e: (Trilochan asked Namdev) “kindly pray for me so that if the Lord accepts, I may also have a glimpse of His blessed vision.”

10.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿਓਸੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
10.t: Thaakur jee no puchhios dharasan kivai tiralochan paavai|
10.e: Namdev asked Thakur, the Lord, as to how Trilochan could have sight of the Lord ?

10.g: ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ।
10.t: has kai Thaakur boliaa naamadheau no keh samajhaavai|
10.e: The Lord God smiled and explained to Naamdev;

10.g: ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਭੇਟੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: hath na aavai bheT so tus tiralochan mai muh laavai|
10.e: “No offerings are needed by me.  Out of my delight only, I would make Trilochan to have sight of me. "

10.g: ਹਉ ਅਧੀਨੁ ਹਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਦੇ ਪਹੁੰਚਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਾਂ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਾਵੈ।
10.t: hau adheen haa(n) bhagat dhe pahu(n)ch na ha(n)ghaa(n) bhagatee dhaavai|
10.e: I am under the total control of the devotees and their loving claims I can never reject; rather I myself also cannot understand them.

10.g: ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
10.t: hoi vicholaa aan milaavai ||12||
10.e: Their loving devotion, in fact, becomes mediator and makes them meet me.”

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਧੰਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਨ
10.t: pauRee 13 : dha(n)naa ate braahaman
10.e: Dhanna and brahmin

10.g: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਪੂਜੈ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਧੰਨਾ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਵੈ।
10.t: baamhan poojai dhevate dha(n)naa guoo charaavan aavai|
10.e: A brahman would worship gods (in the form of stone idols) where Dhanna used to graze his cow.

10.g: ਧੰਨੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਪੁਛੈ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
10.t: dha(n)nai ddiThaa chalit eh puchhai baamhan aakh sunaavai|
10.e: On seeing his worship, Dhanna asked the brahman what he was doing.

10.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
10.t: Thaakur dhee sevaa karai jo ichhai soiee fal paavai|
10.e: “Service to the Thakur (God) gives the desired fruit,” replied the brahman.

10.g: ਧੰਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਭਿ ਦੇਹ ਇਕ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
10.t: dha(n)naa karadhaa jodhaRee mai bh dheh ik je tudh bhaavai|
10.e: Dhanna requested, “O brahman, if you agree kindly give one to me.”

10.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਲਪੇਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇ ਧੰਨੈ ਨੋ ਗੈਲ ਛੁਡਾਵੈ।
10.t: pathar ik lapeT kar dhe dha(n)nai no gail chhuddaavai|
10.e: The brahman rolled a stone, gave it to Dhanna and thus got rid of him.

10.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਛਾਹਿ ਰੋਟੀ ਲੈ ਭੋਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
10.t: Thaakur no nhaavaal kai chhaeh roTee lai bhog chaRhaavai|
10.e: Dhanna bathed the Thakur and offered him bread and buttermilk.

10.g: ਹਥਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਿਨਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
10.t: hath joR minat karai pairee pai pai bahut manaavai|
10.e: With folded hands and falling at the feet of the stone he begged for his service to be accepted.

10.g: ਹਉ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਨ ਜੁਠਾਲਸਾਂ ਤੂ ਰੁਠਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
10.t: hau bhee muh na juThaalasaa(n) too ruThaa mai kih na sukhaavai|
10.e: Dhanna said, “I will also not eat because how can I be happy if you are annoyed.”

10.g: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਹਿ ਛਾਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: gosaiee paratakh hoi roTee khaeh chhaeh muh laavai|
10.e: (Seeing his true and loving devotion) God was forced to appear and eat his bread and buttermilk.

10.g: ਭੋਲਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
10.t: bholaa bhaau gobi(n)dh milaavai ||13||
10.e: In fact, innocence like that of Dhanna makes the sight of the Lord available.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਬੇਣੀ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 14 : benee bhagat
10.e: Beni

10.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਾਂਤੁ ਬਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: gurmukh benee bhagat kar jai ikaa(n)t bahai liv laavai|
10.e: Saint Beni, a gurmukh, used to sit in solitude and would enter a meditative trance.

10.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ।
10.t: karam karai adhiaatamee horas kisai na alakh lakhaavai|
10.e: He would perform spiritual activities and in humbleness would never tell anyone.

10.g: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਲਾਵੈ।
10.t: ghar aaiaa jaa puchheeaai raaj dhuaar giaa aalaavai|
10.e: Reaching back home when asked, he would tell people that he had gone to the door of his king (the Supreme Lord).

10.g: ਘਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੂ ਮੰਗੀਅਨਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਝਤ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ।
10.t: ghar sabh vathoo ma(n)geean val chhal kar kai jhat la(n)ghaavai|
10.e: When his wife asked for some household material he would avoid her and thus spend his time performing spiritual activities.

10.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਓਹ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ।
10.t: vaddaa saa(n)g varatadhaa oh ik man paramesar dhiaavai|
10.e: One day while concentrating on the Lord with single-minded devotion, a strange miracle happened.

10.g: ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਭਗਤ ਦੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਆਵੈ।
10.t: paij savaarai bhagat dhee raajaa hui kai ghar chal aavai|
10.e: To keep the glory of the devotee, God Himself in the form of King went to his house.

10.g: ਦੇਇ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ ਅਣਗਣਤੀ ਖਰਚੀ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਵੈ।
10.t: dhei dhilaasaa tus kai anaganatee kharachee pahu(n)chaavai|
10.e: In great joy, He consoled everyone and made available profuse money for expenditure.

10.g: ਓਥਹੁੰ ਆਇਆ ਭਗਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ।
10.t: othahu(n) aaiaa bhagat paas hoi dhiaal het upajaavai|
10.e: From there He came to His devotee Beni and compassionately loved him.

10.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
10.t: bhagat janaa(n) jaikaar karaavai ||14||
10.e: This way He arranges applause for His devotees.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਕਬੀਰ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ
10.t: pauRee 15 : kabeer ate raamaana(n)dh
10.e: Kabir and Ramanand

10.g: ਹੋਇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਬਨਾਰਸੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਸਾਈਂ।
10.t: hoi birakat banaarasee rahi(n)dhaa raamaana(n)dh gusaiee(n)|
10.e: Being detached from the world, Brahmin Ramanand lived in Varanasi (Kasi).

10.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੇ ਉਠਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣ ਤਾਈਂ।
10.t: a(n)mrit vele uTh kai jaa(n)dhaa ga(n)gaa nhaavan taiee(n)|
10.e: He would rise early in the morning and go to the Ganges to bathe.

10.g: ਅਗੋ ਹੀ ਦੇ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੰਮਾ ਪਿਆ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਿਥਾਈਂ।
10.t: ago hee dhe jai kai la(n)maa piaa kabeer tithaiee(n)|
10.e: Once even before Ramanand, Kabir went there and lay in the way.

10.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਟੁੰਬਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਖ ਸਮਝਾਈ।
10.t: pairee Tu(n)b uThaaliaa bolahu raam sikh samajhaiee|
10.e: Touching with his feet Ramanand awakened Kabir and told him to speak ‘Ram’, the true spiritual teaching.

10.g: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਛੁਹੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਮਹਕਾਈ।
10.t: jiau lohaa paaras chhuhe cha(n)dhan vaas ni(n)m mahakaiee|
10.e: As the iron touched by philosopher’s stone becomes gold and the margosa tree (Azadirachta indica) is made fragrant by sandal.

10.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
10.t: pasoo paretahu dhev kar poore satigur dhee vaddiaaiee|
10.e: The wondrous Guru turns even animals and ghosts into angels.

10.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
10.t: acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh milaiee|
10.e: Meeting the wonderous Guru the disciple wonderfully merges into the great wonderous Lord.

10.g: ਝਰਣਾ ਝਰਦਾ ਨਿਝਰਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਈ।
10.t: jharanaa jharadhaa nijharahu gurmukh baanee aghaR ghaRaiee|
10.e: Then from the Self springs a fountain and the words of the gurmukhs shape a beautiful form

10.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
10.t: raam kabeerai bhedh na bhaiee ||15||
10.e: Now Ram and Kabir became identical.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਸੈਣ ਨਾਈ
10.t: pauRee 16 : sain naiee
10.e: Sain, the barber

10.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਣੁ ਨਾਈ।
10.t: sun parataap kabeer dhaa dhoojaa sikh hoaa sain naiee|
10.e: Hearing of glory of Kabir, Sain also turned to be a disciple.

10.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਈ।
10.t: prem bhagat raatee karai bhalakai raaj dhuaarai jaiee|
10.e: In the night he would immerse in loving devotion and in the morning he would serve at the door of the king.

10.g: ਆਏ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ।
10.t: aae sa(n)t paraahune keeratan hoaa rain sabaiee|
10.e: On one night some sadhus came to him and the whole night was spent in singing the Lord's praises

10.g: ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।
10.t: chhadd na sakai sa(n)t jan raaj dhuaar na sev kamaiee|
10.e: Sain could not leave company of the saints and consequently did not perform the king’s service the following morning.

10.g: ਸੈਣ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਣੈ ਨੋ ਰੀਝਾਈ।
10.t: sain roop har jai kai aaiaa raanai no reejhaiee|
10.e: God himself took the form of Sain. He served the king in such a way that the king was overjoyed.

10.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੋ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਰਮਾਈ।
10.t: saadh janaa(n) no vidhaa kar raaj dhuaar giaa saramaiee|
10.e: Bidding fairwell to the saints, Sain hesitantly arrived at the palace of the king.

10.g: ਰਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਹੁੰ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਗਲਹੁੰ ਕਵਾਇ ਖੋਲਿ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਈ।
10.t: raanai dhoorahu(n) sadh kai galahu(n) kavai khol painhaiee|
10.e: The king From a distance the king called him nearby. He took off his own robes and offered them to Bhagat Sain.

10.g: ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਹਉਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਜੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
10.t: vas keetaa hau(n) tudh aj bolai raajaa sunai lukaiee|
10.e: ‘You have overpowered me’, said the king and his words were heard by one and all.

10.g: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੬॥
10.t: paragaT karai bhagat vaddiaaiee ||16||
10.e: God himself manifests the grandeur of the devotee.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤ
10.t: pauRee 17 : ravidhaas bhagat
10.e: Ravidas

10.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਵਜਿਆ ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਮਿਰੇਟਾ।
10.t: bhagat bhagat jag vajiaa chahu chakaa(n) dhe vich chamireTaa|
10.e: The tanner (Ravidas) became renowned as bhagat (saint) in all the four directions.

10.g: ਪਾਣ੍ਹਾ ਗੰਢੈ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਢੋਇ ਢੋਰ ਸਮੇਟਾ।
10.t: paanhaa ga(n)ddai raeh vich kulaa dharam ddoi ddor sameTaa|
10.e: In accordance with his family tradition he would cobble the shoes and carry away the dead animals.

10.g: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚੀਥੜੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਲੇਟਾ।
10.t: jiau kar maile cheethaRe heeraa laal amol paleTaa|
10.e: This was his outward routine but in reality he was a gem wrapped in rags.

10.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹੇਟਾ।
10.t: chahu varanaa upadhesadhaa giaan dhiaan kar bhagat saheTaa|
10.e: He would preach all the four varnas (castes).  His preaching made them rapt in the meditative devotion for the Lord.

10.g: ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਗਾ ਥੇਟਾ।
10.t: nhaavan aaiaa sa(n)g mil baanaaras kar ga(n)gaa theTaa|
10.e: Once, a group of people went to Kasi (Varanasi) to have their sacred dip in the Ganges.

10.g: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੈ ਗੰਗਾ ਦੀ ਭੇਟਾ।
10.t: kadd kaseeraa saupiaa ravidhaasai ga(n)gaa dhee bheTaa|
10.e: Ravidas gave one dhela (half a pice) to one member and asked him to offer it to the Ganges.

10.g: ਲਗਾ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚ ਦਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮੇਟਾ।
10.t: lagaa purab abheech dhaa ddiThaa chalit acharaj ameTaa|
10.e: A great festival of Abhijit naksatr (star) was on there where the public saw this wonderful episode.

10.g: ਲਇਆ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਤਾਣਾ ਪੇਟਾ।
10.t: liaa kaseeraa hath kadd soot ik jiau taanaa peTaa|
10.e: Ganges, herself taking out her hand accepted that paltry amount, dhela, and proved that Ravidas was one with Ganges as warp and weft.

10.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਬੇਟਾ ॥੧੭॥
10.t: bhagat janaa(n) har maa(n) piau beTaa ||17||
10.e: For bhagats (saints,) God is their mother, father and son all in one.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਅਹੱਲਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਗੋਤਮ
10.t: pauRee 18 : aha'liaa ate gotam
10.e: Ahalya and Gautam

10.g: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ।
10.t: gotam naar ahiliaa tis no dhekh i(n)dhrr lobhaanaa|
10.e: Ahalya was the wife of Gautam. When Indar, the king of gods, set eyes on her, he was overcome with lust.

10.g: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਪਛੋਤਾਣਾ।
10.t: par ghar jai saraap lai hoi sahas bhag pachhotaanaa|
10.e: He entered their house, got curse of being with thousands of pudendums and repented.

10.g: ਸੁੰਞਾ ਹੋਆ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੁ ਲੁਕਿਆ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਮਾਣਾ।
10.t: su(n)n(j)aa hoaa i(n)dhrr lok lukiaa saravar man saramaanaa|
10.e: The Indralok (abode of Indr) became desolate and getting ashamed of himself he hid in a pond.

10.g: ਸਹਸ ਭਗਹੁ ਲੋਇਣ ਸਹਸ ਲੈਂਦੋਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਿਧਾਣਾ।
10.t: sahas bhagahu loin sahas lai(n)dhoiee i(n)dhr puree sidhaanaa|
10.e: On revocation of the curse when all those holes became eyes, only then he returned to his habitat.

10.g: ਸਤੀ ਸਤਹੁ ਟਲਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ।
10.t: satee satahu Tal silaa hoi nadhee kinaarai baajh paraanaa|
10.e: Ahalya who could not remain steadfast in her chastity became stone and remained lying on the river bank

10.g: ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਚਰਣਿ ਛੁਹੰਦਿਆ ਚਲੀ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਣੇ ਬਿਬਾਣਾ।
10.t: raghupat charan chhuha(n)dhiaa chalee surag pur bane bibaanaa|
10.e: Touching the (holy) feet of Ram, she was lifted to the heavens.

10.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਲਿਆਈਅਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਾ।
10.t: bhagat vachhal bhaliaaieeahu patit udhaaran paap kamaanaa|
10.e: Because of His benevolence He is mother-like to the devotees and being forgiver of the sinners He is called redeemer of the fallen ones.

10.g: ਗੁਣ ਨੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ।
10.t: gun no gun sabh ko karai aaugun keete gun tis jaanaa|
10.e: Doing good is returned by good gestures always, but he who does good to the evil is known as virtuous.

10.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
10.t: abigat gat kiaa aakh vakhaanaa ||18||
10.e: How can I explain the greatness of that unmanifest (Lord).

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਬਟਵਾੜਾ
10.t: pauRee 19 : baalameek baTavaaRaa
10.e: Valmiki

10.g: ਵਾਟੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਮਾਰਦਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਵਟਵਾੜਾ।
10.t: vaaTai maanas maaradhaa baiThaa baalameek vaTavaaRaa|
10.e: Valmeel was a highwayman Valmiki who would rob and kill travellers passing by.

10.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਆ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ।
10.t: pooraa satigur bheTiaa man vich hoaa khi(n)jotaaRaa|
10.e: Then he began serving the true Guru, Now his mind became diffident about his work.

10.g: ਮਾਰਨ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘ ਹਥੁ ਉਘਾੜਾ।
10.t: maaran no lochai ghanaa kadd na ha(n)gh hath ughaaRaa|
10.e: His mind still urged to kill people but his hands would not obey.

10.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਉਛੇਹਾੜਾ।
10.t: satigur manooaa raakhiaa hoi na aavai uchhehaaRaa|
10.e: The true Guru made his mind tranquil and all the volition of mind came to an end.

10.g: ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਅਨੁ ਰੋਜਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ।
10.t: aaugun sabh paragaasian rojagaar hai eh asaaRaa|
10.e: He unfolded all the evils of mind before the Guru and said, ‘O Lord, this is a profession for me.’

10.g: ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਘਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਅਸਾੜਾ।
10.t: ghar vich puchhan ghaliaa a(n)t kaal hai koi asaaRaa|
10.e: The Guru asked him to enquire at home as to which family members would be co-partner him of his evil deeds at death.

10.g: ਕੋੜਮੜਾ ਚਉਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਝਾੜਾ।
10.t: koRamaRaa chaukha(n)neeaai koi na belee karadhe jhaaRaa|
10.e: But although his family were always ready to be sacrifice unto him, none of them were ready to accept responsibility.

10.g: ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਟਪਿ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਉਪਰ ਵਾੜਾ।
10.t: sach dhiraRai udhaarian Tap nikathaa upar vaaRaa|
10.e: On returning, the Guru placed the sermon of truth within his heart and made him a liberated one. With a single leap he was released from the net of worldliness.

10.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਹਾੜਾ ॥੧੯॥
10.t: gurmukh la(n)ghe paap pahaaRaa ||19||
10.e: Becoming gurmukh, one becomes capable of jumping across mountains of sins.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਅਜਾਮਲ
10.t: pauRee 20 : ajaamal
10.e: Ajamil

10.g: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਲਾਵਤਣੀ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ।
10.t: patit ajaamal paap kar jai kalaavatanee dhe rahiaa|
10.e: Ajamil, the fallen sinner lived with a prostitute.

10.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਹਿਆ।
10.t: gur te bemukh hoi kai paap kamaavai dhuramat dhahiaa|
10.e: He became an apostate. He was entangled in the cobweb of evil deeds.

10.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਵਹਿਆ।
10.t: birathaa janam gavaiaa bhavajal a(n)dhar firadhaa vahiaa|
10.e: His life was wasted in futile deeds and was tossed and thrown within the terrifying worldly ocean.

10.g: ਛਿਅ ਪੁਤ ਜਾਏ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਪਾਪਾ ਦੇ ਫਲ ਇਛੇ ਲਹਿਆ।
10.t: chhia put jaae vesuaa paapaa dhe fal ichhe lahiaa|
10.e: While with the prostitute, he became the father of six sons.  As a result of her bad deeds they all became dangerous robbers.

10.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਉਪੰਨਾਂ ਸਤਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਣ ਨੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਉਮਹਿਆ।
10.t: put upa(n)naa(n) satavaa(n) naau dharan no chit umahiaa|
10.e: A seventh son was born and he began to consider a name for the child.

10.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹਿਆ।
10.t: guroo dhuaarai jai kai gurmukh naau narain kahiaa|
10.e: He visited the Guru who named his son Narayan (a name for God).

10.g: ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਵੇਖਿ ਪੁਤ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਛਹਿਆ।
10.t: a(n)takaal jamadhoot vekh put narain bolai chhahiaa|
10.e: At the end of his life, seeing the messengers of death Ajamil cried for Narayan.

10.g: ਜਮ ਗਣ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਰਗ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਸਹਿਆ।
10.t: jam gan maare har janaa(n) giaa surag jam dda(n)dd na sahiaa|
10.e: The name of God made the death messengers take to their heels. Ajamil went to heaven and did not suffer the beatings from the club of the messengers of death.

10.g: ਨਾਇ ਲਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
10.t: nai le dhukh dderaa ddahiaa ||20||
10.e: Utterance of Name of the Lord dispels all sorrow.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧ : ਗਨਿਕਾ
10.t: pauRee 21 : ganikaa
10.e: The Prostitute

10.g: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਾਪਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਦਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ।
10.t: ganikaa paapan hoi kai paapaa(n) dhaa gal haar parotaa|
10.e: Gankaa was a sinful prostitute who wore the necklace of misdeeds around her neck.

10.g: ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਚਾਣਚਕ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਵਾੜੇ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਤਾ।
10.t: mahaa(n) purakh aachaanachak ganikaa vaaRe aai khalotaa|
10.e: Once a great man was passing by who halted in her courtyard.

10.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਥਹੁ ਉਸ ਨੋ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਤੋਤਾ।
10.t: dhuramat dhekh dhiaal hoi hathahu us no dhiton totaa|
10.e: Seeing her bad plight he became compassionate and offered her a special parrot.

10.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਦੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਸਓਤਾ।
10.t: raam naam upadhes kar khel giaa dhe vanaj sotaa|
10.e: He told her to teach the parrot to repeat the name of Ram. Having made her understand this fruitful trade he then went away.

10.g: ਲਿਵ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੋਤਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਏ ਕਰੈ ਅਸੋਤਾ।
10.t: liv lagee tis totiahu nit paRhaae karai asotaa|
10.e: Each and every day, with full concentration, she would teach the parrot to say Ram.

10.g: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਲੇਵਰੁ ਧੋਤਾ।
10.t: patit udhaaran raam naam dhuramat paap kalevar dhotaa|
10.e: The name of Lord is the liberator of the fallen ones. It washed away her evil wisdom and deeds.

10.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਰਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਧੁ ਸੁ ਗੋਤਾ।
10.t: a(n)t kaal jam jaal toR narakai vich na khaadhu su gotaa|
10.e: At the time of death, it cut away the noose of Yama - the messenger of death she did not have to drown in the ocean of hell.

10.g: ਗਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਬਿਬਾਣਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਨਾਉਂ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਛੋਤਿ ਅਛੋਤਾ।
10.t: giee baiku(n)Th bibaan chaReh naau(n) rasain chhot achhotaa|
10.e: Due to the elixir of name (of the Lord) she became totally devoid of sins and was lifted to the heavens.

10.g: ਥਾਉਂ ਨਿਥਾਵੇਂ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਣੋਤਾ ॥੨੧॥
10.t: thaau(n) nithaave(n) maan manotaa ||21||
10.e: The name (of the Lord) is the last refuge of the shelterless ones.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨ : ਪੂਤਨਾ
10.t: pauRee 22 : pootanaa
10.e: Putana

10.g: ਆਈ ਪਾਪਣਿ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਦੁਹੀ ਥਣੀ ਵਿਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਵਹੇਲੀ।
10.t: aaiee paapan pootanaa dhuhee thanee vih lai vahelee|
10.e: The ill-reputed Putana applied poison on both of her teats.

10.g: ਆਇ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨੇਹੁੰ ਲਾਇ ਨਵਹਾਣਿ ਨਵੇਲੀ।
10.t: aai baiThee paravaar vich nehu(n) lai navahaan navelee|
10.e: She came to the family (of Nand) and started to express her newfound love for the family.

10.g: ਕੁਛੜਿ ਲਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਚੇਟਕੁ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਮਹੇਲੀ।
10.t: kuchhaR le govi(n)dh rai kar cheTak chatura(n)g mahelee|
10.e: Through her clever deception, she lifted Krishna in her lap.

10.g: ਮੋਹਣੁ ਮੰਮੇ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਈ ਗਰਬ ਗਹੇਲੀ।
10.t: mohan ma(n)me paion baahar aaiee garab gahelee|
10.e: With great pride she pressed her breast teat in the mouth of Krishna and came out.

10.g: ਦੇਹ ਵਧਾਇ ਉਚਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਚਰਿਆਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਠਿਖੇਲੀ।
10.t: dheh vadhai uchaian teh chariaar naar aThikhelee|
10.e: Now she expanded her body to a great extent.

10.g: ਤਿਹੁੰ ਲੋਆਂ ਦਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਦੇ ਚੰਬੜਿਆ ਗਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ।
10.t: tihu(n) loaa(n) dhaa bhaar dhe cha(n)baRiaa gal hoi dhuhelee|
10.e: Krishna also becoming the full weight of the three worlds hung from and stuck to her neck.

10.g: ਖਾਇ ਪਛਾੜ ਪਹਾੜ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਈ ਓਜਾੜਿ ਧਕੇਲੀ।
10.t: khai pachhaaR pahaaR vaa(n)g jai piee ojaaR dhakelee|
10.e: Getting unconscious, and like a mountain she fell down into the forest.

10.g: ਕੀਤੀ ਮਾਊ ਤੁਲਿ ਸਹੇਲੀ ॥੨੨॥
10.t: keetee maauoo tul sahelee ||22||
10.e: Krishna liberated her at last and gave her status of equal to his mother’s friend.

10.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੩ : ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਜੀ ਦਾ ਬਧਿਕ ਹੱਥੋਂ ਅੰਤ
10.t: pauRee 23 : sree kirashan jee dhaa badhik ha'tho(n) a(n)t
10.e: Demise of Krishna at the hands of a hunter

10.g: ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤਾ ਪਰਭਾਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੋਡੇ ਉਤੇ ਪੈਰ ਪਸਾਰੇ।
10.t: jai sutaa parabhaas vich godde ute pair pasaare|
10.e: At the sacred place of Prabhas, Krishna slept cross legged with his foot on his knee.

10.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਹੈ ਝਿਲਮਿਲ ਝਲਕੇ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਤਾਰੇ।
10.t: charan kaval vich padham hai jhilamil jhalake vaa(n)gee taare|
10.e: The lotus sign in his foot was illuminating like a star.

10.g: ਬਧਕੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਾਲਦਾ ਮਿਰਗੈ ਜਾਣਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਲੈ ਮਾਰੇ।
10.t: badhak aaiaa bhaaladhaa miragai jaan baan lai maare|
10.e: A hunter came and considering it an eye of a deer, shot the arrow.

10.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੋਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ।
10.t: dharasan ddiThos jai kai karan palaav kare pukaare|
10.e: As he approached, he realised it was Krishna. He became full of sorrow and begged forgiveness.

10.g: ਗਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੀਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ।
10.t: gal vich leetaa kirasan jee avagun keetaa har naa chitaare|
10.e: Krishna ignored his wrong act and embraced him.

10.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ।
10.t: kar kirapaa sa(n)tokhiaa patit udhaaran biradh beechaare|
10.e: Gracefully Krishna asked him to be full of perseverance and gave sactuary to the wrongdoer.

10.g: ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
10.t: bhale bhale kar ma(n)neean buriaa(n) dhe har kaaj savaare|
10.e: The good is said good by everyone but the works of the evil doers are set right by the Lord only.

10.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਂਦੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨੩॥੧੦॥
10.t: paap kare(n)dhe patit udhaare ||23||10||
10.e: He has liberated many fallen sinners.
